```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

/**
 * FASE 1 spike (feature/exoplayer-spike): pure ExoPlayer end-of-stream
 * classifier. Ports the NativeAudioEngine.onCompletion decision chain to a
 * dependency-free unit so plain JUnit can cover it (see
 * ExoEosClassifierTest); ExoPlaybackEngine delegates to it on STATE_ENDED.
 *
 * Decision order (same as native):
 * 1. fileComplete -> GENUINE (Fix A: audio exhausted whatever the metadata
 *    duration skew; epsilon widening cannot cover tens-of-seconds overshoot).
 * 2. byte-exhausted (consumed >= available - chunk) but writer NOT terminal
 *    -> PREMATURE (BUG A guard: a paused/partial file starving the reader is
 *    a buffer underrun, not an EOS).
 * 3. byte-exhausted and writer terminal (FAILED/COMPLETE recorded... COMPLETE
 *    already returned above, so in practice FAILED with all bytes consumed)
 *    -> GENUINE.
 * 4. pos within epsilon of effective duration -> GENUINE.
 * 5. else PREMATURE, with same-spot give-up counters (native parity):
 *    - byte data available + same spot x SAME_SPOT_GIVE_UP(4) -> GENUINE
 *      (bounded, never an infinite stop-resume loop on unparseable clusters).
 *    - no byte data + same spot x2 -> GENUINE (original anti-loop).
 *
 * Byte formula identical to SongCache.isByteRangeEos:
 * available > 0 && consumed > 0 && consumed >= available - chunk.
 */
public final class ExoEosClassifier {

    public enum Verdict {
        GENUINE,
        PREMATURE
    }

    public static final int SAME_SPOT_GIVE_UP = 4;
    private static final long SAME_SPOT_TOLERANCE_MS = 1000;

    private long lastPrematurePosMs = -1;
    private int lastPrematureSameCount = 0;

    /** New track or explicit seek: drop same-spot history. */
    public void reset() {
        lastPrematurePosMs = -1;
        lastPrematureSameCount = 0;
    }

    public static boolean isByteExhausted(long consumedBytes,
            long availableBytes, long chunkBytes) {
        return availableBytes > 0 && consumedBytes > 0
                && consumedBytes >= availableBytes - chunkBytes;
    }

    /**
     * @param consumedBytes bytes the DataSource actually served
     * @param availableBytes bytes on disk (.part/.webm length)
     * @param chunkBytes production chunk size (102400)
     * @param fileComplete record COMPLETE + size validated
     * @param writerTerminal no more data can ever arrive (record FAILED)
     * @param posMs player position at end
     * @param effDurMs effective duration (min of metadata / player reading)
     * @param epsilonMs genuine window (3000 incomplete, 15000 complete)
     */
    public Verdict classify(long consumedBytes, long availableBytes,
            long chunkBytes, boolean fileComplete, boolean writerTerminal,
            long posMs, long effDurMs, long epsilonMs) {
        // 1. Fix A.
        if (fileComplete) return Verdict.GENUINE;
        boolean byteEos = isByteExhausted(consumedBytes, availableBytes,
                chunkBytes);
        // 2+3. BUG A guard.
        if (byteEos) {
            return writerTerminal ? Verdict.GENUINE : Verdict.PREMATURE;
        }
        // 4. Duration epsilon.
        if (effDurMs > 0 && posMs >= effDurMs - epsilonMs) {
            return Verdict.GENUINE;
        }
        // 5. Same-spot give-up (shared counter, native parity).
        boolean byteDataAvailable = consumedBytes > 0 && availableBytes > 0;
        int sameSpotCount = notePrematureLocked(posMs);
        if (byteDataAvailable) {
            return sameSpotCount >= SAME_SPOT_GIVE_UP
                    ? Verdict.GENUINE : Verdict.PREMATURE;
        }
        return sameSpotCount >= 2 ? Verdict.GENUINE : Verdict.PREMATURE;
    }

    /**
     * Records a premature end at posMs. Returns the consecutive same-spot
     * count (+-1000ms repeats are deterministic, not transient glitches).
     * Exposed for tests; classify() calls it internally.
     */
    public int notePrematureLocked(long posMs) {
        if (lastPrematurePosMs >= 0
                && Math.abs(posMs - lastPrematurePosMs)
                        <= SAME_SPOT_TOLERANCE_MS) {
            lastPrematureSameCount++;
        } else {
            lastPrematurePosMs = posMs;
            lastPrematureSameCount = 1;
        }
        return lastPrematureSameCount;
    }
}
```

```java
 * LoadControl (tuned for growing-file playback):
 * - bufferForPlaybackMs 2500, afterRebuffer 5000
 * - targetBufferBytes 8MB, prioritizeTimeOverSize true
 * - backBuffer 30s

 * consumed(DataSource mark) vs available(SongCache.localBytes) ->
 * genuine => onEnded, premature => onError(PREMATURE_END). No auto-recovery
 * in the spike (FASE 2 decides); errors and 500ms position ticks are logged
 * with the [EXO] prefix for the FASE 1 comparison report.

public final class ExoPlaybackEngine {

    private static final String TAG = "DnialifyVisionOS";

    public static ExoPlayer sharedPlayer() {

    public static void setSharedPlayerListener(PlayerReadyListener listener) {
        sharedPlayerListener = listener;

        if (listener != null && current != null) listener.onPlayerReady(current);
    }

    public interface Listener {
        void onEnded(String videoId, long posMs, long consumedBytes,
                long availableBytes, String verdict);
        void onError(String videoId, String reason, long posMs);

            if (ready != null) ready.onPlayerReady(player);
            player.setHandleAudioBecomingNoisy(true);
            if (android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 21) {
                setAudioSessionId(C.generateAudioSessionIdV21(ac));
            }
            player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
                @Override public void onAudioSessionIdChanged(int sessionId) {
                    audioSessionId = sessionId;
                    if (audioSessionListener != null) {
                        audioSessionListener.onAudioSessionId(sessionId);
                    }
                }
            });
            player.addListener(playerListener);
    }

    public void pause() {
        main.post(() -> {
            if (player != null) player.pause();
        });
    }

    public void resume() {
        main.post(() -> {
            if (player != null) player.play();
        });
    }

    public void stop() {
        main.post(() -> {
            stopPoll();
            releasePlayer();
            videoId = "";
        });
    }

    public void seekTo(int ms) {
        main.post(() -> {
            if (player != null) {
                classifier.reset();
                player.seekTo(Math.max(0, ms));
            }
        });
    }

    public void release() {
        main.post(() -> {
            endDelegate = null;
            stopPoll();
            releasePlayer();
        });
    }

    // ---------- internals ----------

    private GrowingFileDataSource.FileState fileStateFor(Context ac,
            String vid) {
        return new GrowingFileDataSource.FileState() {
            @Override public File currentFile() {
                try {
                    if (SongCache.isComplete(ac, vid)) {
                        File fin = SongCache.audioFile(ac, vid);
                        if (fin != null && fin.isFile()) return fin;
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    return SongCache.partFile(ac, vid);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return null;
                }
            }

            @Override public long totalBytes() {
                return -1L; // spike: unknown until COMPLETE; LENGTH_UNSET ok
            }

            @Override public boolean isComplete() {
                try {
                    return SongCache.isComplete(ac, vid);
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            @Override public boolean isFailed() {
                try {
                    return SongCache.ST_FAILED.equals(
                            SongCache.getStatus(ac, vid));
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        };
    }

    private boolean waitForPrefix(Context ac, String vid) {
        long need = 2L * 102400L;
        long lastSeen = -1;
        long lastMoveAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (;;) {
            try {
                if (SongCache.hasBytes(ac, vid, need)) return true;
                if (SongCache.ST_FAILED.equals(SongCache.getStatus(ac, vid))) {
                    return false;
                }
                long have = SongCache.localBytes(ac, vid);
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (have != lastSeen) {
                    lastSeen = have;
                    lastMoveAt = now;
                } else if (now - lastMoveAt > SongCache.TIMEOUT_MS
                        && !SongCache.isDownloading(vid)) {
                    return false;
                }
                Thread.sleep(250);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return false;
            } catch (Exception e) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    private void startItem(Context ac, String vid, String title, int startMs) {
        if (player == null || !vid.equals(videoId)) return;
        File f;
        try {
            f = SongCache.isComplete(ac, vid) ? SongCache.audioFile(ac, vid)
                    : SongCache.partFile(ac, vid);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            postError(vid, "FILE_RESOLVE", 0);
            return;
        }
        Uri uri = Uri.fromFile(f);
        DataSource.Factory upstream = dsFactory;
        MediaSource source = new ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(upstream)
                .createMediaSource(MediaItem.fromUri(uri));
        if (title != null && !title.isEmpty()) {
            Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] play videoId=" + vid + " title=" + title
                    + " startMs=" + startMs + " uri=" + uri);
        } else {
            Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] play videoId=" + vid + " startMs=" + startMs
                    + " uri=" + uri);
        }
        // FASE 2 seek preservation: start offset applied at prepare time.
        // setMediaSource(source, startMs), not setMediaItem(uri, startMs):
        // the custom GrowingFileDataSource.Factory (OPSI C direct .part
        // reads) only plugs in via a custom MediaSource.
        if (startMs > 0) {
            player.setMediaSource(source, startMs);
        } else {
            player.setMediaSource(source);
        }
        player.prepare();
        player.play();
        lastTickMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        startPoll();
    }

    /**
     * FASE 1 REVISI: MediaSource https via CacheDataSource + SimpleCache.
     * FASE 2: CacheDataSource -> ResolvingDataSource -> HttpDataSource.
     * SongCache/file:// tak dipakai di path ini.
     */
    private void startHttpsItem(Context ac, String vid, String title,
            int startMs, String url, java.util.List<String> ids,
            int startIndex) {
        if (player == null || !vid.equals(videoId)) return;
        // Playlist: tiap item placeholder per-id + key per-id (URL expire
        // aman, cache hit per videoId). Fallback singleton bila queue kosong.
        java.util.List<MediaItem> items = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        if (ids == null || ids.isEmpty()) {
            items.add(new MediaItem.Builder().setUri(Uri.parse(url))
                    .setCustomCacheKey(vid).build());
        } else {
            for (String id : ids) {
                if (id == null || id.isEmpty()) continue;
                items.add(new MediaItem.Builder()
                        .setUri(Uri.parse("https://resolve/" + id))
                        .setCustomCacheKey(id).build());
            }
            if (items.isEmpty()) {
                items.add(new MediaItem.Builder().setUri(Uri.parse(url))
                        .setCustomCacheKey(vid).build());
            }
        }
        int fromIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(startIndex, items.size() - 1));
        // Upstream http untuk fetch URL fresh.
        DataSource.Factory httpFactory = new DefaultHttpDataSource.Factory();
        // Resolve per open dari item key (bukan vid tangkap): tiap item
        // playlist resolve URL sendiri. 1x retry VD baru; gagal -> IOException.
        ResolvingDataSource.Factory resolvingFactory =
                new ResolvingDataSource.Factory(httpFactory, dataSpec -> {
                    String id = dataSpec.key != null ? dataSpec.key : vid;
                    try {
                        String freshUrl = VisionOsResolver.resolve(id).url;
                        Log.d(TAG, "[RESOLVE] videoId=" + id + " url="
                                + freshUrl.substring(0,
                                        Math.min(60, freshUrl.length())) + "...");
                        return dataSpec.buildUpon()
                                .setUri(Uri.parse(freshUrl)).setKey(id).build();
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        Log.d(TAG, "[RESOLVE] retry videoId=" + id
                                + " reason=" + e.getMessage());
                        try {
                            VisionOsResolver.refreshVisitor();
                            String retryUrl = VisionOsResolver.resolve(id).url;
                            return dataSpec.buildUpon()
                                    .setUri(Uri.parse(retryUrl)).setKey(id).build();
                        } catch (Exception e2) {
                            throw new java.io.IOException(e2);
                        }
                    }
                });
        CacheDataSource.Factory cacheFactory = new CacheDataSource.Factory()
                .setCache(CacheManager.getPlayerCache(ac))
                .setUpstreamDataSourceFactory(resolvingFactory)
                .setCacheKeyFactory(spec -> spec.key != null ? spec.key : vid)
                .setFlags(CacheDataSource.FLAG_IGNORE_CACHE_ON_ERROR);
        ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory sourceFactory =
                new ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(cacheFactory);
        java.util.List<MediaSource> sources = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (MediaItem mediaItem : items) {
            sources.add(sourceFactory.createMediaSource(mediaItem));
        }
        Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] play videoId=" + vid + " url=" + url
                + " playlist=" + items.size() + " fromIndex=" + fromIndex);
        // Seek preservation: offset at prepare time (sama seperti path growing).
        // Multi-item: each item uses same cache/resolver factory.
        if (items.size() > 1) {
            player.setMediaSources(sources, fromIndex, startMs);
        } else if (startMs > 0) {
            player.setMediaSource(sources.get(0), startMs);
        } else {
            player.setMediaSource(sources.get(0));
        }
        player.prepare();
        player.play();
        SimpleCache cache = CacheManager.getPlayerCache(ac);
        long cached = cache.getCachedBytes(vid, 0, C.LENGTH_UNSET);
        Log.d(TAG, "[CACHE] videoId=" + vid + " cachedBytes=" + cached);
        lastTickMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        startPoll();
    }

    private final Player.Listener playerListener = new Player.Listener() {
        @Override
        public void onPlaybackStateChanged(int state) {
            if (player == null) return;
            String vid = videoId;
            long pos = safePos();
            long buf = safeBuffered();
            String name;
            switch (state) {
                case Player.STATE_IDLE: name = "IDLE"; break;
                case Player.STATE_BUFFERING: name = "BUFFERING"; break;
                case Player.STATE_READY: name = "READY"; break;
                case Player.STATE_ENDED: name = "ENDED"; break;
                default: name = "?" + state; break;
            }
            Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] state=" + name + " pos=" + pos + " buf=" + buf
                    + " load=" + (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastTickMs)
                    + " videoId=" + vid);
            Listener l = listener;
            if (l != null) l.onStateChanged(vid, name, pos, buf);
            reportPlayerState(vid, state);
            if (state == Player.STATE_ENDED) onExoEnded(vid, pos);
        }

        @Override
        public void onIsPlayingChanged(boolean isPlaying) {
            if (player == null) return;
            reportPlayerState(videoId, player.getPlaybackState());
        }

        @Override
        public void onPlayerError(PlaybackException error) {            String vid = videoId;
            long pos = safePos();
            String reason = error == null ? "UNKNOWN"
                    : ("code=" + error.errorCode);
            Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] error=" + reason + " pos=" + pos
                    + " videoId=" + vid + " cause=" + error);
            postError(vid, reason, pos);
        }

        @Override
        public void onPositionDiscontinuity(Player.PositionInfo oldPosition,
                Player.PositionInfo newPosition, int reason) {
            if (reason != Player.DISCONTINUITY_REASON_SEEK) return;
            EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
            if (delegate == null) return;
            String vid = videoId;
            long pos = safePos();
            main.post(() -> delegate.onSeekDone(vid, pos));
        }

        @Override
        public void onMediaItemTransition(MediaItem mediaItem,
                int reason) {
            // FASE 3 Fix1: auto-advance antar item playlist. Manual next/prev
            // dari notif tetap via JS (COMMAND_INVALID intercept), jadi yang
            // sampai sini hanya transisi otomatis player.
            if (reason != Player.DISCONTINUITY_REASON_AUTO_TRANSITION) return;
            if (mediaItem == null || mediaItem.localConfiguration == null) return;
            android.net.Uri u = mediaItem.localConfiguration.uri;
            if (u == null) return;
            String path = u.toString();
            String nid = path.substring(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
            if (nid.isEmpty()) return;
            EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
            if (delegate == null) return;
            main.post(() -> delegate.onPlaylistAdvanced(nid));
        }
    };

    /** Forward raw state facts to the owner (mirror path). Already main thread. */
    private void reportPlayerState(String vid, int playbackState) {
        EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
        if (delegate == null) return;
        boolean playing = false;
        try {
            playing = player != null && player.isPlaying();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        delegate.onPlayerState(vid, playbackState, playing);
    }

    private void onExoEnded(String vid, long pos) {
        long consumed = dsFactory != null ? dsFactory.consumedBytes() : -1L;
        long available = -1L;
        boolean complete = false;
        boolean terminal = false;
        try {
            if (appCtx != null) {
                available = SongCache.localBytes(appCtx, vid);
                complete = SongCache.isComplete(appCtx, vid);
                String st = SongCache.getStatus(appCtx, vid);
                terminal = complete || SongCache.ST_FAILED.equals(st);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
        if (delegate != null) {
            // FASE 2: owner classifies + recovers; report raw facts only.
            final long c = consumed, a = available;
            main.post(() -> delegate.onPlayerEnded(vid, pos, c, a));
            return;
        }
        long effDur = player != null && player.getDuration() > 0
                ? player.getDuration() : -1L;
        ExoEosClassifier.Verdict v = classifier.classify(consumed, available,
                102400L, complete, terminal, pos, effDur,
                complete ? 15000L : 3000L);
        String verdict = v == ExoEosClassifier.Verdict.GENUINE ? "genuine"
                : "premature";
        Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] onCompletion pos=" + pos + " consumed=" + consumed
                + " available=" + available + " verdict=" + verdict
                + " videoId=" + vid);
        Listener l = listener;
        if (v == ExoEosClassifier.Verdict.GENUINE) {
            if (l != null) l.onEnded(vid, pos, consumed, available, verdict);
        } else {
            if (l != null) l.onError(vid, "PREMATURE_END", pos);
        }
    }

    private void pollOnce() {
        if (!pollOn || player == null) return;
        long pos = safePos();
        long dur = -1L;
        try {
            dur = player.getDuration();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        long buf = safeBuffered();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (pos != lastPosMs) {
            lastPosMs = pos;
            lastPosWallMs = now;
        } else if (player.isPlaying() && now - lastPosWallMs > 3000) {
            // FASE 2: with a delegate the owner (tick) re-drives the window;
            // report only. Standalone keeps the visible STALL_3S error.
            Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] stall pos=" + pos + " videoId=" + videoId);
            EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
            if (delegate != null) {
                final long p = pos;
                final String v = videoId;
                main.post(() -> delegate.onPlayerStalled(v, p));
            } else {
                Listener l = listener;
                if (l != null) l.onError(videoId, "STALL_3S", pos);
            }
            lastPosWallMs = now;
        }
        Listener l = listener;
        if (l != null) l.onPositionChanged(videoId, pos, dur, buf);
        poller.postDelayed(poll, 500);
    }

    private void startPoll() {
        if (pollOn) return;
        pollOn = true;
        lastPosMs = -1;
        lastPosWallMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        poller.postDelayed(poll, 500);
    }

    private void stopPoll() {
        pollOn = false;
        poller.removeCallbacks(poll);
    }

    private long safePos() {
        try {
            return player != null ? player.getCurrentPosition() : -1L;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1L;
        }
    }

    private long safeBuffered() {
        try {
            return player != null ? player.getBufferedPosition() : -1L;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1L;
        }
    }

    private void postError(String vid, String reason, long pos) {
        Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] error=" + reason + " pos=" + pos + " videoId=" + vid);
        main.post(() -> {
            EndDelegate delegate = endDelegate;
            if (delegate != null) {
                delegate.onEngineError(vid, reason, pos);
                return;
            }
            Listener l = listener;
            if (l != null) l.onError(vid, reason, pos);
        });
    }

    private void releasePlayer() {
        stopPoll();
        if (player != null) {
            ExoPlayer released = player;
            try {
                player.removeListener(playerListener);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                player.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (sharedPlayer == released) {
                sharedPlayer = null;
                PlayerReadyListener ready = sharedPlayerListener;
                if (ready != null) ready.onPlayerReleased(released);
            }
            player = null;
        }
        dsFactory = null;
    }
}
```

```java
        ctrls.setOrientation(LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL);
        ctrls.addView(mkButton("Play", v -> doPlay()), rowWeight());
        ctrls.addView(mkButton("Pause", v -> engine.pause()), rowWeight());
        ctrls.addView(mkButton("Resume", v -> engine.resume()), rowWeight());
        ctrls.addView(mkButton("+10s", v -> doSeekRel(10000)), rowWeight());
        ctrls.addView(mkButton("Stop", v -> engine.stop()), rowWeight());
        root.addView(ctrls);

        statusView = new TextView(this);
        statusView.setMovementMethod(new ScrollingMovementMethod());
        statusView.setTextIsSelectable(true);
        ScrollView scroll = new ScrollView(this);
        scroll.addView(statusView);
        root.addView(scroll, new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f));

        setContentView(root);
        append("[EXO] spike ready. USE_EXOPLAYER=" + ExoPlayerFlags.USE_EXOPLAYER);
        registerTestReceiver();
        // FASE A: intent-driven auto-play for scripts/test-exo-vs-media.sh.
        try {
            Intent intent = getIntent();
            String extraVid = intent != null
                    ? intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_VIDEO_ID) : null;
            boolean autoplay = intent != null
                    && intent.getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_AUTOPLAY, false);
            exitOnEnd = intent != null
                    && intent.getBooleanExtra(EXTRA_EXIT_ON_END, false);
            try {
                winSize = intent != null
                        ? Math.max(1, Math.min(99, intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_WINDOW, 2))) : 2;
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                winSize = 2;
            }
            append("[EXO] windowSize=" + winSize + " (production default 2)");
            if (extraVid != null && !extraVid.trim().isEmpty()) {
                idInput.setText(extraVid.trim());
            }
            // FASE 2 native mode: drive NativeAudioEngine (flag override) and
            // auto-advance on ENDED, mirroring JS nextTrack. Spike path below.
            String mode = intent != null ? intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_MODE) : null;
            if ("native".equals(mode)) {
                nativeMode = true;
                try {
                    targetPlays = Math.max(1, intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_TARGET_PLAYS, 10));
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try {
                    songTimeoutSec = Math.max(120, intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_SONG_TIMEOUT, 600));
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] native mode target=" + targetPlays
                        + " songTimeout=" + songTimeoutSec + "s");
                main.postDelayed(this::nativeStart, 1000);
            } else if (autoplay) {
                final String vid = currentId();
                append("[EXO] autoplay videoId=" + vid + " exitOnEnd="
                        + exitOnEnd);
                main.postDelayed(() -> doPlay(vid), 1000);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[EXO] autoplay setup failed " + e);
        }
    }

    @Override

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        try {
            main.removeCallbacks(nativePoll);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            main.removeCallbacks(winTick);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        winActive = false;
        try {
            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test-destroy");
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            stopService(new android.content.Intent(this, TestForegroundService.class));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {
            ExoPlayerFlags.setOverrideForTest(null);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        try {

        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        testReceiver = null;
        try {
            engine.release();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        super.onDestroy();
    }

    /** Dynamic controls for the auto-test script (no manifest receiver). */
    private void registerTestReceiver() {
        try {
            if (testReceiver != null) return;
            testReceiver = new BroadcastReceiver() {
                @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
                    if (intent == null || intent.getAction() == null) return;
                    String a = intent.getAction();
                    if (ACTION_TEST_STOP.equals(a)) {
                        append("[EXO] broadcast STOP");
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test-broadcast");
                            else engine.stop();
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    } else if (ACTION_TEST_EXIT.equals(a)) {
                        append("[EXO] broadcast EXIT");
                        finish();
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_PAUSE.equals(a)) {
                        append("[TEST2D] action=pause nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().pause();
                            else engine.pause();
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TEST2D] pause failed " + e);
                        }
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_PLAY.equals(a)) {
                        append("[TEST2D] action=play nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().resume();
                            else engine.resume();
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TEST2D] play failed " + e);
                        }
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_NEXT.equals(a)) {
                        append("[TEST2D] action=next nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) {
                                try {
                                    NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test2d-next");
                                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                main.removeCallbacks(nativePoll);
                                main.postDelayed(
                                        ExoPlaybackTestActivity.this::nativeAdvance, 1000);
                            }
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TEST2D] next failed " + e);
                        }
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_PREV.equals(a)) {
                        append("[TEST2D] action=prev nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode && playIndex > 0) {
                                playIndex -= 2;
                                try {
                                    NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test2d-prev");
                                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                main.removeCallbacks(nativePoll);
                                main.postDelayed(
                                        ExoPlaybackTestActivity.this::nativeAdvance, 1000);
                            }
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TEST2D] prev failed " + e);
                        }
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_SEEK.equals(a)) {
                        int sec = intent.getIntExtra("seconds", 10);
                        append("[TEST2D] action=seek seconds=" + sec
                                + " nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().seek(sec);
                            else engine.seekTo(sec * 1000);
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TEST2D] seek failed " + e);
                        }
                    } else if (ACTION_MEDIA_VOLUME.equals(a)) {
                        int pct = intent.getIntExtra("percent", 100);
                        append("[TESTVOL] action=volume percent=" + pct
                                + " nativeMode=" + nativeMode);
                        try {
                            if (nativeMode) NativeAudioEngine.get().setVolumePercent(pct);
                        } catch (Exception e) {
                            append("[TESTVOL] volume failed " + e);
                        }
                    }
                }
            };
            IntentFilter filter = new IntentFilter();
            filter.addAction(ACTION_TEST_STOP);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_TEST_EXIT);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_PAUSE);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_PLAY);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_NEXT);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_PREV);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_SEEK);
            filter.addAction(ACTION_MEDIA_VOLUME);
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
                // Test-only harness: shell (adb) broadcasts must reach the
                // receiver; NOT_EXPORTED silently drops them on API 33+.
                registerReceiver(testReceiver, filter, Context.RECEIVER_EXPORTED);
            } else {
                registerReceiver(testReceiver, filter);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[EXO] receiver register failed " + e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * FASE 2 integration run: NativeAudioEngine with the exo backend, polled
     * for ENDED/ERROR like JS nextTrack would. Cycles the 3 probe songs until
     * targetPlays completions. Test-only; production UI untouched.
     */
    private void nativeStart() {
        try {
            // FASE 4: pref flag menang atas hardcoded TRUE sehingga baseline
            // MediaPlayer bisa jalan lewat harness yang sama.
            boolean prefSet = false;
            try {
                prefSet = getSharedPreferences(ExoPlayerFlags.PREFS, MODE_PRIVATE)
                        .contains(ExoPlayerFlags.KEY_TEST_USE_EXO);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (prefSet) ExoPlayerFlags.syncFromPrefs(getApplicationContext());
            else ExoPlayerFlags.setOverrideForTest(Boolean.TRUE);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] FATAL override failed " + e);
            finish();
            return;
        }
        append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] backend=" + (ExoPlayerFlags.useExo() ? "exo" : "mediaplayer"));
        if (!ExoPlayerFlags.useExo()) {
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] FATAL flag not applied");
            finish();
            return;
        }
        nativeAdvance();
    }

    private void nativeAdvance() {
        if (playsDone >= targetPlays) {
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] DONE completed=" + playsDone
                    + " errors=" + playsError + " timeouts=" + playsTimeout);
            try {
                NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test-done");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                ExoPlayerFlags.setOverrideForTest(null);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (exitOnEnd) finish();
            return;
        }
        playIndex++;
        playVid = PROBES[playIndex % PROBES.length];
        playStartedAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#" + (playsDone + 1) + " videoId=" + playVid);
        try {
            NativeAudioEngine.get().play(this, playVid, playVid, "", "");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#" + (playsDone + 1) + " videoId=" + playVid
                    + " EXCEPTION " + e);
            playsError++;
            playsDone++;
            main.postDelayed(this::nativeAdvance, 2000);
            return;
        }
        main.removeCallbacks(nativePoll);
        main.postDelayed(nativePoll, 2000);
    }

    private void nativePollOnce() {
        String state = "?";
        String backend = "?";
        double cur = -1;
        double dur = -1;
        String reason = "";
        try {
            org.json.JSONObject s = NativeAudioEngine.get().getState();
            state = s.optString("state", "?");
            backend = s.optString("backend", "?");
            cur = s.optDouble("currentTime", -1);
            dur = s.optDouble("duration", -1);
            reason = s.optString("reason", "");
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] poll failed " + e);
        }
        long elapsed = (System.currentTimeMillis() - playStartedAt) / 1000;
        notifTick("Exo Test: " + playVid + " | play " + (playsDone + 1) + "/" + targetPlays
                + " | " + state);
        if ("ENDED".equals(state)) {
            playsDone++;
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#" + playsDone + " videoId=" + playVid
                    + " ENDED endPos=" + Math.round(cur * 1000)
                    + " dur=" + Math.round(dur * 1000) + " backend=" + backend);
            main.postDelayed(this::nativeAdvance, 2000);
            return;
        }
        if ("ERROR".equals(state)) {
            playsDone++;
            playsError++;
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#" + playsDone + " videoId=" + playVid
                    + " ERROR reason=" + reason + " pos=" + Math.round(cur * 1000));
            main.postDelayed(this::nativeAdvance, 2000);
            return;
        }
        if (elapsed > songTimeoutSec) {
            playsDone++;
            playsTimeout++;
            append("[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#" + playsDone + " videoId=" + playVid
                    + " TIMEOUT after " + elapsed + "s state=" + state);
            try {
                NativeAudioEngine.get().stop("test-timeout");
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            main.postDelayed(this::nativeAdvance, 2000);
            return;
        }
        main.postDelayed(nativePoll, 5000);
    }

    /** B4: throttled notification status (5s) for the foreground guard. */
    private void notifTick(String s) {
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        if (now - lastNotifMs < 5000) return;
        lastNotifMs = now;
        try {
            TestForegroundService.updateStatus(s);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private Button mkButton(String label, android.view.View.OnClickListener l) {
        Button b = new Button(this);
        b.setText(label);
        b.setOnClickListener(l);
        return b;
    }

    private LinearLayout.LayoutParams rowWeight() {
        return new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,
                ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f);
    }

    private String currentId() {
        try {
            String s = String.valueOf(idInput.getText()).trim();
            return s.isEmpty() ? PROBES[0] : s;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return PROBES[0];
        }
    }

    private void doPlay() {
        doPlay(currentId());
    }

    private void doPlay(final String vid) {
        append("[EXO] play requested videoId=" + vid);
        // Fresh window per play (production resets windowChunk/windowEnd too).
        winVid = vid;
        winTotal = -1;
        winDurMs = 0;
        winChunk = -1;
        winEnd = -1;
        winSlides = 0;
        winActive = false;
        winSawReady = false;
        winLoggedComplete = false;
        main.removeCallbacks(winTick);
        new Thread(() -> {
            try {
                // Same resolve path as the native engine (read-only reuse,
                // no existing file modified).
                VisionOsResolver.Result r = VisionOsResolver.resolve(vid);
                final String url = r.url;
                final long total = clenOf(url);
                final long durMs = r.durationMs;
                if (total > 0) {
                    // B3: prime the window BEFORE/AWITH the writer so the cap
                    // applies from byte 0 (production: setWindow at start).
                    main.post(() -> primeWindow(vid, url, total, durMs));
                    new Thread(() -> SongCache.download(
                            getApplicationContext(), vid, url, total)).start();
                }
                main.post(() -> engine.play(ExoPlaybackTestActivity.this, vid,
                        vid, 0));
            } catch (Exception e) {
                final String msg = String.valueOf(e);
                main.post(() -> append("[EXO] resolve failed videoId=" + vid
                        + " err=" + msg));
            }
        }).start();
    }

    /** Start window enforcement for this play (main thread). */
    private void primeWindow(String vid, String url, long total, long durMs) {
        if (!vid.equals(winVid) && !vid.equals(currentId())) return;
        winVid = vid;
        winTotal = total;
        winDurMs = durMs;
        lastWinVid = vid;
        lastWinUrl = url != null ? url : "";
        lastWinTotal = total;
        winChunk = -1;
        winEnd = -1;
        winActive = total > 0 && durMs > 0;
        if (winActive) {
            append("[EXO] download start videoId=" + vid + " total=" + total);
            windowTick();
        }
    }

    /**
     * B4 sliding window (main thread, 500ms): same math as
     * NativeAudioEngine.setWindow — chunk of curMs + winSize chunks ahead as
     * hard cap; pause writer on cap-hit, resume when behind and idle.
     */
    private void windowTick() {
        main.removeCallbacks(winTick);
        if (!winActive) return;
        final String vid = winVid;
        final long total = winTotal;
        final long durMs = winDurMs;
        if (vid.isEmpty() || total <= 0 || durMs <= 0) {
            winActive = false;
            return;
        }
        try {
            android.content.Context ac = getApplicationContext();
            // Download finished -> nothing to cap; log once and stand down.
            if (SongCache.ST_COMPLETE.equals(SongCache.getStatus(ac, vid))) {
                if (!winLoggedComplete) {
                    winLoggedComplete = true;
                    append("[EXO] download complete videoId=" + vid + " slides=" + winSlides);
                }
                winActive = false;
                return;
            }
            long one = SongCache.chunkEndFor(0, (int) Math.min(durMs, Integer.MAX_VALUE), total);
            if (one <= 0) one = total;
            long curMs = Math.max(0, lastPosMs);
            long edge = SongCache.chunkEndFor(curMs,
                    (int) Math.min(durMs, Integer.MAX_VALUE), total);
            long end = Math.min(total, edge + (long) winSize * one);
            int chunk = one > 0 ? (int) ((total * curMs / durMs) / one) : 0;
            if (chunk != winChunk) {
                winChunk = chunk;
                winEnd = end;
                winSlides++;
                append("[EXO] window set chunk=" + chunk + " end=" + end
                        + " curMs=" + curMs + " slides=" + winSlides);
            } else {
                winEnd = end;
            }
            long have = SongCache.localBytes(ac, vid);
            long cap = Math.min(winEnd > 0 ? winEnd : total, total);
            if (have >= cap && SongCache.isDownloading(vid)) {
                SongCache.pauseDownload(vid);
                append("[EXO] pause reason=cap-hit have=" + have + " end=" + cap);
            } else if (!SongCache.isDownloading(vid) && have < cap) {
                append("[EXO] download start chunk=" + winChunk + " have=" + have
                        + " end=" + cap);
                final android.content.Context fc = ac;
                // URL/total for resume: re-resolve is wasteful; reuse last
                // known writer params via a fresh resolve-free restart is
                // impossible without production hooks, so re-download call
                // resumes from .part (Range resume is built into download()).
                // NOTE: needs url — captured via last resolve below.
                if (lastWinUrl != null && !lastWinUrl.isEmpty() && vid.equals(lastWinVid)) {
                    final String fu = lastWinUrl;
                    final long ft = lastWinTotal;
                    new Thread(() -> SongCache.download(fc, vid, fu, ft)).start();
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            append("[EXO] window tick failed " + e);
        }
        main.postDelayed(winTick, 500);
    }

    private long clenOf(String url) {
        java.net.HttpURLConnection h = null;
        try {
            h = (java.net.HttpURLConnection) new java.net.URL(url)
                    .openConnection();
            h.setRequestMethod("HEAD");
            h.setConnectTimeout(10000);
            h.setReadTimeout(10000);
            h.connect();
            long n = h.getContentLengthLong();
            return n > 0 ? n : -1L;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return -1L;
        } finally {
            try {
                if (h != null) h.disconnect();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
    }

    private void doSeekRel(int deltaMs) {
        long target = Math.max(0, lastPosMs + deltaMs);
        append("[EXO] seek rel +" + deltaMs + "ms -> " + target + "ms");
        engine.seekTo((int) Math.min(target, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
    }

    private void setStatus(final String s) {
        main.post(() -> {
            try {
                // Keep last event line pinned; full history in logcat.
                String cur = statusView.getText().toString();
                int nl = cur.lastIndexOf('\n');
                String head = nl >= 0 ? cur.substring(0, nl + 1) : "";
                // Bound buffer: drop head past ~200 lines.
                int lines = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < head.length(); i++) {
                    if (head.charAt(i) == '\n') lines++;
                }
                if (lines > 200) {
                    int cut = head.indexOf('\n', head.length() / 2);
                    if (cut > 0) head = head.substring(cut + 1);
                }
                statusView.setText(head + s);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }

    private void append(final String s) {
        Log.d(TAG, s);
        // FASE C1: mirror to persistent file (best effort, never fails UI).
        try {
            final java.io.File f = logFile;
            if (f != null) {
                synchronized (logFileLock) {
                    java.io.FileOutputStream out = null;
                    try {
                        out = new java.io.FileOutputStream(f, true);
                        out.write((s + "\n").getBytes("UTF-8"));
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {
                    } finally {
                        try {
                            if (out != null) out.close();
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        main.post(() -> {
            try {
                logBuf.append(s).append('\n');
                if (logBuf.length() > 60000) {
                    logBuf.delete(0, logBuf.length() - 60000);
                }
                statusView.setText(logBuf.toString());
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        });
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

/**
 * FASE 1 spike (feature/exoplayer-spike): feature flag for the
 * MediaPlayer -> ExoPlayer (Media3) migration.
 *
 * false (default): production path unchanged, android.media.MediaPlayer
 * via NativeAudioEngine. ExoPlaybackEngine + GrowingFileDataSource exist
 * but are only reachable from ExoPlaybackTestActivity (standalone spike).
 *
 * No existing file reads this flag yet on purpose: FASE 2 decides the
 * integration point. Flipping to true changes nothing until then.
 */
public final class ExoPlayerFlags {
    private ExoPlayerFlags() {}

    public static final boolean USE_EXOPLAYER = true;

    /**
     * Test-only override (null = no override, use USE_EXOPLAYER).
     * Set by the spike/integration harness activities; production never sets
     * it, so release behavior is exactly USE_EXOPLAYER=false (MediaPlayer).
     */
    private static volatile Boolean overrideForTest;

    public static void setOverrideForTest(Boolean v) {
        overrideForTest = v;
    }

    /** Backend selector read by NativeAudioEngine. */
    public static boolean useExo() {
        Boolean o = overrideForTest;
        return o != null ? o : USE_EXOPLAYER;
    }

    /**
     * FASE 4 test hook (rekomendasi opencode A1): runtime override via
     * SharedPreferences key "test_use_exoplayer" (file "exo_test").
     * Ditulis headless via ExoTestFlagReceiver (debug-only). Production
     * default tetap USE_EXOPLAYER=false; tanpa pref, perilaku tak berubah.
     */
    public static final String PREFS = "exo_test";
    public static final String KEY_TEST_USE_EXO = "test_use_exoplayer";

    public static void syncFromPrefs(android.content.Context c) {
        try {
            android.content.SharedPreferences p = c.getSharedPreferences(
                    PREFS, android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
            if (p.contains(KEY_TEST_USE_EXO)) {
                setOverrideForTest(p.getBoolean(KEY_TEST_USE_EXO, false));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

/**
 * FASE 2: pure exo recovery budget. Native parity notes:
 * - MediaPlayer path: soft-seek + 3 hard attempts, then PREMATURE_COMPLETION
 *   ERROR (JS never auto-nexts).
 * - ExoPlayer path: seekTo+play (no re-prepare needed), up to MAX_ATTEMPTS;
 *   budget exhausted -> treat as genuine end (bounded, never an infinite
 *   stop-resume loop). Zero Android deps -> plain JUnit (ExoRecoveryPolicyTest).
 */
public final class ExoRecoveryPolicy {

    /** Attempts before giving up and treating the end as genuine. */
    public static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4;

    private int attempts;

    /** New track or explicit seek: fresh budget. */
    public void reset() {
        attempts = 0;
    }

    /**
     * Consume one attempt. Returns true when another recovery try is allowed,
     * false when the budget is exhausted (caller treats end as genuine).
     */
    public boolean consumeAttempt() {
        if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) return false;
        attempts++;
        return true;
    }

    public int attemptsUsed() {
        return attempts;
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import androidx.media3.common.Player;

/**
 * FASE 2: pure ExoPlayer -> native state mapping.
 *
 * Task table:
 * - STATE_IDLE -> IDLE
 * - STATE_BUFFERING -> BUFFERING
 * - STATE_READY + isPlaying -> PLAYING
 * - STATE_READY + !isPlaying -> PAUSED
 * - STATE_ENDED -> CLASSIFICATION (sentinel, NOT a direct state)
 *
 * ENDED is deliberately NOT mapped to a native state: the raw end fact
 * already travels via EndDelegate.onPlayerEnded into
 * NativeAudioEngine.handlePlaybackEnd (Fix A complete-file, Fix B
 * player-duration bound, byte-range EOS, anti-loop, recovery). Mapping
 * ENDED straight to native ENDED here would bypass premature detection
 * and auto-next unfinished tracks as genuine. The owner ignores ENDED in
 * the mirror path; the classification path sets ENDED + pushAll itself.
 *
 * Zero Android deps (Player import is compile-time int constants only;
 * no player instance touched) -> plain JUnit (ExoStateMirrorTest).
 */
public final class ExoStateMirror {

    private ExoStateMirror() {}

    /** Mirror result. ENDED_NOT_MAPPED = classification path owns it. */
    public enum Mapped {
        IDLE,
        BUFFERING,
        PLAYING,
        PAUSED,
        ENDED_NOT_MAPPED
    }

    /**
     * Map raw ExoPlayer facts to a native target.
     *
     * @param playbackState one of Player.STATE_* (IDLE=1, BUFFERING=2,
     *     READY=3, ENDED=4)
     * @param isPlaying Player.isPlaying() at the time of the callback
     */
    public static Mapped map(int playbackState, boolean isPlaying) {
        switch (playbackState) {
            case Player.STATE_IDLE: return Mapped.IDLE;
            case Player.STATE_BUFFERING: return Mapped.BUFFERING;
            case Player.STATE_READY: return isPlaying ? Mapped.PLAYING : Mapped.PAUSED;
            case Player.STATE_ENDED: return Mapped.ENDED_NOT_MAPPED;
            default: return Mapped.BUFFERING;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import android.content.BroadcastReceiver;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;

/**
 * FASE 4 headless flag setter (debug-only). Production behavior untouched:
 * release builds ignore the broadcast. Writes SharedPreferences
 * "exo_test"/"test_use_exoplayer", consumed by
 * ExoPlayerFlags.syncFromPrefs() on the next NativeAudioEngine.play().
 *
 * Set:   adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.SET_EXO_FLAG --ez value true
 * Clear: adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.SET_EXO_FLAG --ez value false
 */
public final class ExoTestFlagReceiver extends BroadcastReceiver {
    public static final String ACTION = "com.dnialify.SET_EXO_FLAG";

    @Override public void onReceive(Context context, Intent intent) {
        // Debug-only: BuildConfig tak tersedia di modul ini, pakai flag apk.
        try {
            boolean debug = (context.getApplicationInfo().flags
                    & android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_DEBUGGABLE) != 0;
            if (!debug) return;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return;
        }
        if (intent == null || !ACTION.equals(intent.getAction())) return;
        boolean v = intent.getBooleanExtra("value", false);
        try {
            context.getSharedPreferences(ExoPlayerFlags.PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                    .edit().putBoolean(ExoPlayerFlags.KEY_TEST_USE_EXO, v).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        Log.d("EXOFLAG", "[EXOFLAG] set test_use_exoplayer=" + v);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

/** Pure volume mapping shared by ExoPlayer volume and enhancer paths. */
public final class ExoVolumePolicy {
    private ExoVolumePolicy() {}

    public static float playerVolume(int percent) {
        return Math.min(1f, Math.max(0f, percent / 100f));
    }

    public static float linearGain(int percent) {
        return Math.max(0f, percent / 100f);
    }

    /** LoudnessEnhancer target gain in millibels for a linear multiplier. */
    public static int gainMb(int percent) {
        float gain = linearGain(percent);
        if (gain <= 1f) return 0;
        return Math.round((float) (2000d * Math.log10(gain)));
    }

    public static int duckPercent(int percent) {
        return Math.max(0, Math.round(percent * 0.5f));
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import android.net.Uri;
import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
import androidx.media3.common.C;
import androidx.media3.datasource.BaseDataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSource;
import androidx.media3.datasource.DataSpec;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;

/**
 * FASE 1 spike (feature/exoplayer-spike): OPSI C DataSource.
 *
 * Reads the SongCache `.part`/`.webm` file DIRECTLY (no LSS HTTP proxy).
 * A growing file looks like an ordinary (stalling, never truncating) stream:
 * reads block (100ms poll, 20s timeout -- same constants as
 * LocalStreamServer.HoldStream) while the writer fills, EOF
 * (RESULT_END_OF_INPUT) only at true end, writer FAILED surfaces as
 * IOException so ExoPlayer retries/errors visibly.
 *
 * Read verdicts come from {@link GrowingReadPolicy} (plain-JUnit covered).
 * The file is re-resolved every loop iteration so the atomic
 * `.part -> .webm` rename on COMPLETE is picked up mid-read.
 *
 * NativeAudioEngine.java is untouched; only ExoPlaybackEngine (spike) and
 * ExoPlaybackTestActivity (standalone) use this class.
 */
public final class GrowingFileDataSource extends BaseDataSource {

    static final String TAG = "DnialifyVisionOS";

    /** Snapshot of cache state; implemented by the caller (test activity). */
    public interface FileState {
        /** File to read right now (.part while growing, final after COMPLETE). */
        File currentFile();
        /** Content length when known, -1 unknown. */
        long totalBytes();
        /** Record COMPLETE: no more data will ever arrive. */
        boolean isComplete();
        /** Record FAILED: writer dead. */
        boolean isFailed();
    }

    /**
     * H1: reader→writer wake signal. Fired ONCE on HOLD entry (flag reset on
     * successful READ), debounced to 500ms across re-entries, so a starving
     * reader can wake a window-capped writer even while the native tick /
     * watchdog / stall-delegate are all dead (BUFFERING liveness gap).
     */
    public interface HoldListener {
        void onReaderHold(String videoId, long pos, long have);
    }

    private static final long HOLD_NOTIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS = 500;

    /** Factory holding one FileState; exposes last instance's consumed mark. */
    public static final class Factory implements DataSource.Factory {
        private final FileState state;
        private volatile GrowingFileDataSource last;
        private volatile String holdVideoId = "";
        private volatile HoldListener holdListener;

        public Factory(FileState state) {
            this.state = state;
        }

        /** H1 wake path: applied to every instance this factory creates. */
        public void setHoldListener(String videoId, HoldListener l) {
            holdVideoId = videoId != null ? videoId : "";
            holdListener = l;
            GrowingFileDataSource d = last;
            if (d != null) d.setHoldListener(holdVideoId, l);
        }

        @Override
        public DataSource createDataSource() {
            last = new GrowingFileDataSource(state);
            last.setHoldListener(holdVideoId, holdListener);
            return last;
        }

        /** Bytes served so far (consumed mark, mirrors LSS servedBytes). */
        public long consumedBytes() {
            GrowingFileDataSource d = last;
            return d == null ? -1L : d.consumedBytes();
        }
    }

    // H1+H4 instance state (outer DataSource; Factory above keeps its own copy).
    private String holdVideoId = "";
    private volatile HoldListener holdListener;
    private boolean holdNotified;
    private long lastHoldNotifyMs;

    public void setHoldListener(String videoId, HoldListener l) {
        holdVideoId = videoId != null ? videoId : "";
        holdListener = l;
    }

    private static final int POLL_MS = 100;
    private static final long HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS = 20000;
    private static final int SERVE_BUF = 65536;

    private final FileState state;

    @Nullable private Uri uri;
    private long position;
    private long consumed;
    private boolean opened;
    private long lastNeedLogMs;

    public GrowingFileDataSource(FileState state) {
        super(false);
        this.state = state;
    }

    /** Highest byte position served (consumed mark for EOS classification). */
    public long consumedBytes() {
        return consumed;
    }

    @Override
    public long open(DataSpec dataSpec) throws IOException {
        transferInitializing(dataSpec);
        uri = dataSpec.uri;
        position = dataSpec.position;
        // Block until the file exists (prefix fill) or terminal/timeout,
        // so prepare() never sees a frozen empty snapshot.
        long bornAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (;;) {
            File f = state.currentFile();
            if (f != null && f.isFile() && f.length() > 0) break;
            if (state.isFailed()) {
                throw new IOException("growing-file writer FAILED videoId?");
            }
            if (state.isComplete()) {
                throw new IOException("growing-file COMPLETE but unreadable");
            }
            if (System.currentTimeMillis() - bornAt > HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS) {
                throw new IOException("growing-file prefix timeout 20s uri=" + uri);
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(POLL_MS);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                throw new IOException("growing-file open interrupted");
            }
        }
        opened = true;
        transferStarted(dataSpec);
        long len = dataSpec.length;
        return len != C.LENGTH_UNSET ? len : C.LENGTH_UNSET;
    }

    @Override
    public int read(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length) throws IOException {
        if (length == 0) return 0;
        if (!opened) throw new IOException("read before open");
        long bornAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (;;) {
            File f = state.currentFile();
            long have = (f != null && f.isFile()) ? f.length() : 0;
            GrowingReadPolicy.Action action = GrowingReadPolicy.decide(
                    position, have, state.isComplete(), state.isFailed(),
                    state.totalBytes());
            switch (action) {
                case READ: {
                    long want = Math.min((long) length, have - position);
                    if (want <= 0) {
                        // Raced shrink/rename: re-resolve next iteration.
                        continue;
                    }
                    RandomAccessFile raf = null;
                    try {
                        raf = new RandomAccessFile(f, "r");
                        raf.seek(position);
                        int n = raf.read(buffer, offset,
                                (int) Math.min(want, SERVE_BUF));
                        if (n < 0) continue;
                        position += n;
                        if (position > consumed) consumed = position;
                        bytesTransferred(n);
                        holdNotified = false; // HOLD exit: re-arm entry signal
                        return n;
                    } catch (IOException e) {
                        throw e;
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        throw new IOException(String.valueOf(e));
                    } finally {
                        try {
                            if (raf != null) raf.close();
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                }
                case END_OF_INPUT:
                    return C.RESULT_END_OF_INPUT;
                case ERROR_FAILED:
                    throw new IOException("growing-file writer FAILED");
                case HOLD:
                default: {
                    long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                    // H1: single wake call on HOLD entry (any state, no tick
                    // needed), debounced; re-armed by the next READ above.
                    if (!holdNotified) {
                        holdNotified = true;
                        HoldListener hl = holdListener;
                        if (hl != null && now - lastHoldNotifyMs
                                >= HOLD_NOTIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
                            lastHoldNotifyMs = now;
                            final long p = position, h = have;
                            final String v = holdVideoId;
                            try {
                                hl.onReaderHold(v, p, h);
                            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                        }
                    }
                    // C1: throttled starvation log (5s) for the window test.
                    if (now - lastNeedLogMs > 5000) {
                        lastNeedLogMs = now;
                        Log.d(TAG, "[EXO] byte needed pos=" + position + " have=" + have
                                + " waited=" + (now - bornAt) + "ms");
                    }
                    if (now - bornAt > HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS) {
                        throw new IOException("growing-file hold timeout 20s"
                                + " pos=" + position + " have=" + have);
                    }
                    try {
                        Thread.sleep(POLL_MS);
                    } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        throw new IOException("growing-file read interrupted");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public Uri getUri() {
        return uri;
    }

    @Override
    public void close() {
        uri = null;
        if (opened) {
            opened = false;
            transferEnded();
        }
    }
}
```

### Path: android/app/src/main/java/com/dnialify/musicstream/GrowingReadPolicy.java

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

/**
 * FASE 1 spike (feature/exoplayer-spike): pure growing-file read decision.
 *
 * Zero Android/Media3 imports so plain JUnit can cover it (see
 * GrowingReadPolicyTest). GrowingFileDataSource delegates every read-loop
 * iteration to {@link #decide}; the blocking/hold/timeout stays in the
 * DataSource, the verdict lives here.
 *
 * Mirrors LocalStreamServer.HoldStream semantics:
 * - bytes available -> READ
 * - nothing yet, writer alive -> HOLD (caller polls, bounded by timeout)
 * - nothing left and record COMPLETE -> END_OF_INPUT (true EOF only here)
 * - writer FAILED -> ERROR_FAILED (caller throws so ExoPlayer retries/errors)
 */
public final class GrowingReadPolicy {

    public enum Action {
        READ,
        HOLD,
        END_OF_INPUT,
        ERROR_FAILED
    }

    private GrowingReadPolicy() {}

    /**
     * @param pos      current read position (bytes from file start)
     * @param have     current file length on disk
     * @param complete record COMPLETE (no more data will ever arrive,
     *                 final file resolved by caller)
     * @param failed   record FAILED (writer dead)
     * @param total    content length when known, -1 unknown
     */
    public static Action decide(long pos, long have, boolean complete,
            boolean failed, long total) {
        if (failed) return Action.ERROR_FAILED;
        if (pos < have) return Action.READ;
        if (complete) return Action.END_OF_INPUT;
        // Incomplete file, reader caught up with the writer: hold for more
        // bytes even when pos >= total (writer behind quota/stall -> the
        // hold timeout, not EOF, resolves it -- same as LSS).
        return Action.HOLD;
    }
}
```

### Path: android/app/src/main/java/com/dnialify/musicstream/LocalStreamServer.java

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import android.content.Context;
import fi.iki.elonen.NanoHTTPD;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.RandomAccessFile;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Local HTTP proxy: MediaPlayer reads cache files through
 * http://127.0.0.1:PORT/local-stream/{videoId} instead of setDataSource(path).
 * A growing .part file looks like an ordinary (stalling, never truncating)
 * HTTP stream: Range seeks land instantly when bytes exist, block (hold)
 * while the writer fills, and EOF only at true end. No re-prepare gaps.
 */
public class LocalStreamServer extends NanoHTTPD {
    static final String TAG = "DnialifyVisionOS";
    private static final int HOLD_POLL_MS = 100;
    private static final int HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS = 90000;
    private static final int HOLD_EXTENSION_MS = 30000;
    private static final int MAX_HOLD_EXTENSIONS = 3;
    private static final int SERVE_BUF = 65536;

    private final Context appCtx;

    static final class Track {
        final String videoId;
        volatile String path;
        volatile long total;
        Track(String videoId, String path, long total) {
            this.videoId = videoId;
            this.path = path;
            this.total = total;
        }
    }

    private final Map<String, Track> tracks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    /**
     * High-water mark of bytes served per videoId (Opsi A consumedBytes).
     * Max-merged: seeks open new streams from lower offsets and must never
     * regress the mark. Read by the engine at onCompletion; -1 when unknown.
     */
    private final Map<String, Long> served = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public LocalStreamServer(Context c) {
        super(0); // port 0 = OS picks a free port
        appCtx = c.getApplicationContext();
    }

    public int port() {
        return getListeningPort();
    }

    public void register(String videoId, String path, long total) {
        if (videoId == null || videoId.isEmpty() || path == null) return;
        tracks.put(videoId, new Track(videoId, path, total));
        served.put(videoId, 0L);
    }

    public void unregister(String videoId) {
        if (videoId == null) return;
        tracks.remove(videoId);
        served.remove(videoId);
    }

    /** Bytes served so far for videoId, or -1 when nothing served yet. */
    public long servedBytes(String videoId) {
        Long v = videoId == null ? null : served.get(videoId);
        return v == null ? -1L : v;
    }

    @Override
    public Response serve(IHTTPSession session) {
        String uri = session.getUri();
        String vid = null;
        try {
            if (uri != null && uri.startsWith("/local-stream/")) {
                vid = uri.substring("/local-stream/".length());
                int q = vid.indexOf('?');
                if (q >= 0) vid = vid.substring(0, q);
                int s = vid.indexOf('/');
                if (s >= 0) vid = vid.substring(0, s);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        Track t = vid != null ? tracks.get(vid) : null;
        Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] request range=" + String.valueOf(session.getHeaders().get("range"))
                + " videoId=" + vid + " total=" + (t == null ? -1 : t.total));
        if (t == null) {
            return newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND,
                    "text/plain", "gone");
        }
        long total = t.total;
        if (total <= 0) {
            return newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND,
                    "text/plain", "no-length");
        }
        long start = 0;
        long end = total - 1;
        try {
            String rg = session.getHeaders().get("range");
            if (rg == null) rg = session.getHeaders().get("Range");
            if (rg != null && rg.startsWith("bytes=")) {
                String spec = rg.substring(6).trim();
                int dash = spec.indexOf('-');
                if (dash >= 0) {
                    String a = spec.substring(0, dash).trim();
                    String b = spec.substring(dash + 1).trim();
                    if (!a.isEmpty()) start = Math.max(0, Long.parseLong(a));
                    if (!b.isEmpty()) end = Math.min(total - 1, Long.parseLong(b));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        if (start < 0) start = 0;
        if (end >= total) end = total - 1;
        if (start > end) {
            Response r = newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE,
                    "text/plain", "bad-range");
            r.addHeader("Content-Range", "bytes */" + total);
            return r;
        }
        boolean partial = session.getHeaders().get("range") != null
                || session.getHeaders().get("Range") != null;
        HoldStream in = new HoldStream(t, start, end);
        Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] response start=" + start + " end=" + end
                + " expectedBytes=" + (end - start + 1) + " total=" + total);
        Response r;
        if (partial) {
            r = newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.PARTIAL_CONTENT,
                    "audio/webm", in, end - start + 1);
            r.addHeader("Content-Range",
                    "bytes " + start + "-" + end + "/" + total);
        } else {
            r = newFixedLengthResponse(Response.Status.OK, "audio/webm", in, total);
        }
        r.addHeader("Accept-Ranges", "bytes");
        return r;
    }

    /** Blocking stream: reads file, holds (max 90s + extensions) while writer fills. */
    final class HoldStream extends InputStream {
        private final Track track;
        private final long end;
        private long pos;
        private volatile boolean closed;
        private long bornAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        private int holdExtensions = 0;
        private long lastLoggedHave = -1;
        private boolean loggedHold;

        HoldStream(Track track, long start, long end) {
            this.track = track;
            this.pos = start;
            this.end = end;
        }

        private boolean complete() {
            try {
                JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(appCtx, track.videoId);
                return rec != null
                        && SongCache.ST_COMPLETE.equals(rec.optString("cacheStatus", ""));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        private File sourceFile(boolean isComplete) {
            if (isComplete) {
                File fin = SongCache.audioFile(appCtx, track.videoId);
                if (fin.isFile() && fin.length() == track.total) return fin;
            }
            return new File(track.path);
        }

        @Override
        public int read() throws IOException {
            byte[] b = new byte[1];
            int n = read(b, 0, 1);
            return n < 0 ? -1 : (b[0] & 0xFF);
        }

        @Override
        public int read(byte[] buf, int off, int len) throws IOException {
            if (closed) return -1;
            if (buf == null) throw new NullPointerException();
            if (len <= 0) return 0;
            // track switched/stopped meanwhile -> close, don't serve stale bytes
            Track cur = tracks.get(track.videoId);
            if (cur == null || cur != track) return -1;
            if (pos > end) return -1;
            for (;;) {
                if (closed) return -1;
                Track live = tracks.get(track.videoId);
                if (live == null || live != track) return -1;
                boolean isComplete = complete();
                File source = sourceFile(isComplete);
                long have = source.isFile() ? source.length() : 0;
                if (have != lastLoggedHave) {
                    lastLoggedHave = have;
                    Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] file size now=" + have + " expectedTotal="
                            + track.total + " writerState=" + (isComplete ? "COMPLETE"
                                    : (SongCache.isDownloading(track.videoId) ? "RUNNING" : "NOT_RUNNING"))
                            + " record=" + SongCache.getStatus(appCtx, track.videoId)
                            + " path=" + source.getName());
                }
                if (pos < have) {
                    long want = Math.min((long) len, Math.min(end, have - 1) - pos + 1);
                    if (want <= 0) return -1;
                    RandomAccessFile raf = null;
                    try {
                        raf = new RandomAccessFile(source, "r");
                        raf.seek(pos);
                        int n = raf.read(buf, off, (int) Math.min(want, SERVE_BUF));
                        if (n < 0) return -1;
                        pos += n;
                        served.merge(track.videoId, pos, Math::max);
                        return n;
                    } catch (IOException e) {
                        throw e;
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        throw new IOException(String.valueOf(e));
                    } finally {
                        try {
                            if (raf != null) raf.close();
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                }
                // At complete state, re-resolve final file before declaring EOF.
                if (isComplete) {
                    File fin = SongCache.audioFile(appCtx, track.videoId);
                    if (fin.isFile() && fin.length() == track.total && pos < fin.length()) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if (pos >= track.total) return -1;
                    Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] writer COMPLETE or true EOF pos=" + pos
                            + " total=" + track.total + " finalFile=" + fin.getName() + " closing");
                    return -1;
                }
                if (pos >= track.total) return -1;
                if (!loggedHold) {
                    loggedHold = true;
                    Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] reached current EOF, waiting for writer pos=" + pos
                            + " have=" + have + " end=" + end);
                }
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - bornAt > HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS) {
                    boolean failed = false;
                    try {
                        JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(appCtx, track.videoId);
                        failed = rec != null
                                && SongCache.ST_FAILED.equals(rec.optString("cacheStatus", ""));
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (isComplete || failed) {
                        Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] hold timeout exceeded " + (HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000)
                                + "s pos=" + pos + " have=" + have + " end=" + end
                                + " writerState=" + (isComplete ? "COMPLETE" : "FAILED"));
                        return -1;
                    }
                    if (have < track.total && holdExtensions < MAX_HOLD_EXTENSIONS) {
                        holdExtensions++;
                        bornAt += HOLD_EXTENSION_MS;
                        Log.w(TAG, "[LSS] hold timeout, forcing window advance for videoId="
                                + track.videoId + " ext=" + holdExtensions + "/" + MAX_HOLD_EXTENSIONS);
                        try {
                            NativeAudioEngine.requestWindowAdvance(track.videoId);
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    } else {
                        Log.d(TAG, "[LSS] hold timeout exceeded " + (HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000)
                                + "s pos=" + pos + " have=" + have + " end=" + end
                                + " ext=" + holdExtensions);
                        return -1;
                    }
                }
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(HOLD_POLL_MS);
                } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }
        }

        @Override
        public void close() {
            closed = true;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Date;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;

/**
 * Local shadow of android.util.Log.
 * Writes to real logcat AND to an in-memory ring buffer
 * consumed by the JS layer via LogBridge (see MainActivity).
 *
 * Java resolves same-package classes before imported ones.
 * Remove the platform Log import (android.util) from any file in this package
 * to route its calls here instead of the platform class.
 */
public final class Log {

    private static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 20000;
    private static final Object LOCK = new Object();
    private static final Deque<String> BUFFER = new ArrayDeque<>(1024);
    private static final SimpleDateFormat SDF =
            new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US);

    /** Only these tags are captured at D/I/V level. W/E are always captured. */
    private static final Set<String> TAG_WHITELIST = new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(
            // Playback engine
            "DnialifyVisionOS",
            "NativeAudioEngine",
            "NAE",
            "PlaybackService",
            // Caching
            "SongCache",
            "VisionOsCache",
            "CacheEvents",
```
