            // resume; the state mirror syncs JS). MP path below unchanged.
            if (exoMode) {
                nlog("[FOCUS] ignored in exoMode change=" + change
                        + " (exo manager owns focus)");
                return;
            }
        }
        switch (change) {
            case AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS:
                // Other app took focus permanently (YouTube, etc.)
                // Pause; user must resume manually
                pauseForFocusLoss(false);
                break;
            case AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT:
                // Other app took focus temporarily (call, video ad, etc.)
                // Pause; expect auto-resume
                pauseForFocusLoss(true);
                break;
            case AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK:
                // Notification or short sound — duck volume to 50%
                duckForNotification();
                break;
            case AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN:
                // Focus regained — restore or resume
                restoreFromFocusGain();
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    private void pauseForFocusLoss(boolean autoResume) {
        MediaPlayer player;
        final boolean useExo;
        synchronized (lock) {
            useExo = exoMode && exo != null;
            if (!useExo && mp == null) return;
            player = mp;
            try {
                preLossVolumePercent = getCurrentVolumePercent();
                pausedByFocus = true;
                resumeWhenFocusGained = autoResume;
                if (useExo) exo.pause(); else player.pause();
                setStateLocked(State.PAUSED);
                releaseWakeLock();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.e(TAG, "[FOCUS] pause failed: " + e.getMessage());
                return;
            }
        }
        pushEvent("NATIVE_STATE", "state=PAUSED reason=audio_focus");
        pushAll();
    }

    private void restoreFromFocusGain() {
        if (isDucked) {
            isDucked = false;
            focusHandler.removeCallbacks(this::unduckIfNotGained);
        }
        // Restore volume first
        applyVolumePercent(preLossVolumePercent);
        boolean shouldResume;
        synchronized (lock) {
            shouldResume = pausedByFocus && resumeWhenFocusGained;
            if (shouldResume) {
                pausedByFocus = false;
                resumeWhenFocusGained = false;
            }
        }
        if (shouldResume) {
            synchronized (lock) {
                final boolean useExo = exoMode && exo != null;
                if (!useExo && mp == null) return;
                try {
                    if (useExo) exo.resume(); else mp.start();
                    setStateLocked(State.PLAYING);
                    acquireWakeLock();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "[FOCUS] resume failed: " + e.getMessage());
                    return;
                }
            }
            pushEvent("NATIVE_STATE", "state=PLAYING reason=audio_focus_resume");
            pushAll();
        }
    }

    private void duckForNotification() {
        Log.d(TAG, "[DUCK] duckForNotification start, currentVolumePercent="
                + getCurrentVolumePercent() + " isDucked=" + isDucked);
        Log.d(TAG, "[DUCK] duckForNotification called, preLoss saved=" + preLossVolumePercent
                + " current=" + getCurrentVolumePercent());
        synchronized (lock) {
            if ((exoMode ? exo == null : mp == null) || state != State.PLAYING) return;
        }
        if (isDucked) return; // already ducked, don't re-save preLoss
        preLossVolumePercent = getCurrentVolumePercent();
        isDucked = true;
        applyVolumePercent(ExoVolumePolicy.duckPercent(Math.round(preLossVolumePercent)));
        // Schedule restore — some duck events don't send GAIN back
        focusHandler.removeCallbacks(this::unduckIfNotGained);
        focusHandler.postDelayed(this::unduckIfNotGained, 5000);
    }

    private void unduckIfNotGained() {
        Log.d(TAG, "[DUCK] unduck timer fired, state=" + state + " preLoss=" + preLossVolumePercent
                + " current=" + getCurrentVolumePercent());
        if (!isDucked) return;
        isDucked = false;
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (state != State.PLAYING) return;
        }
        Log.d(TAG, "[DUCK] restoring to " + preLossVolumePercent);
        applyVolumePercent(preLossVolumePercent);
    }

    /** Entry point for NotificationDuckService (package-visible on purpose). */
    public void onExternalNotification(String pkg) {
        Log.d(TAG, "[DUCK] onExternalNotification called pkg=" + pkg
                + " state=" + state + " mp=" + (mp != null) + " exo=" + (exo != null)
                + " instanceHash=" + System.identityHashCode(this));
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (state != State.PLAYING || (exoMode ? exo == null : mp == null)) return;
        }
        duckForNotification();
    }

    public JSONObject getState() {
        synchronized (lock) {
            return snapshotLocked(null);
        }
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        synchronized (lock) {
            return state == State.RESOLVING || state == State.BUFFERING
                    || state == State.PLAYING || state == State.PAUSED
                    || state == State.SEEKING;
        }
    }

    // ---------- internals ----------

    private void resolveAndStart(Context c, String vid, int gen) {
        // 1. cache HIT? record COMPLETE + file valid (repairs stale COMPLETE)
        if (SongCache.isComplete(c, vid)) {
            java.io.File hf = SongCache.audioFile(c, vid);
            nlog("[CACHE] HIT videoId=" + vid + " bytes=" + hf.length());
            synchronized (lock) {
                lastCache = "HIT";
                lastTotal = hf.length();
                playFile = hf.getAbsolutePath();
            }
            startPathAt(hf.getAbsolutePath(), Source.CACHED_AUDIO, c, gen, 0);
            return;
        }
        // legacy flat file without record still counts as HIT (backward compat)
        java.io.File f = VisionOsCache.fileFor(c, vid);
        if (f.isFile() && f.length() > 0 && SongCache.getRecord(c, vid) == null) {
            nlog("[CACHE] HIT(legacy) videoId=" + vid + " bytes=" + f.length());
            synchronized (lock) {
                lastCache = "HIT";
                lastTotal = f.length();
                playFile = f.getAbsolutePath();
            }
            startPathAt(f.getAbsolutePath(), Source.CACHED_AUDIO, c, gen, 0);
            return;
        }
        nlog("[CACHE] MISS videoId=" + vid + " gen=" + gen);
        // FASE 2: path exo tanpa pre-resolve. ResolvingDataSource resolve
        // sendiri per open (expire/403 retry di dalam). Placeholder tak
        // di-fetch (di-intercept sebelum network). MediaPlayer legacy tetap
        // resolve + cache-first di bawah.
        if (exoMode) {
            final int resumeAt;
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (gen != playGen) return;
                resumeAt = Math.max(0, pendingStartMs);
                durationMs = 0;
                lastTotal = -1;
                lastUrl = "";
                lastCache = "MISS";
            }
            startExoUrl("https://resolve/" + vid, vid, gen, resumeAt);
            return;
        }
        // 2. resolve (LOGIN_REQUIRED retry lives inside resolver, max 1x)
        VisionOsResolver.Result r;
        try {
            r = VisionOsResolver.resolve(vid);
        } catch (VisionOsResolver.ResolverException e) {
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (gen != playGen) return;
                failLocked(e.reason != null ? e.reason
                        : VisionOsResolver.R_RESOLVER_FAIL,
                        e.stage + " " + e.getMessage());
            }
            pushAll();
            return;
        }
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen) return;
        }
        nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=CACHE_FILL itag=" + r.itag);
        final String url = r.url;
        // record duration as soon as resolver knows it
        try {
            JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(c, vid);
            if (rec != null && rec.optDouble("duration", 0) <= 0 && r.durationMs > 0) {
                rec.put("duration", r.durationMs / 1000.0);
                SongCache.putRecord(c, vid, rec);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        final long total = clenOf(url);
        if (total <= 0) {            // bottom fallback only: no length, chunking impossible -> legacy stream
            nlog("[CACHE] total<=0, bottom-fallback stream videoId=" + vid);
            synchronized (lock) {
                lastCache = "MISS";
            }
            startUrl(url, Source.VISIONOS);
            return;
        }
        synchronized (lock) {
            lastTotal = total;
            lastUrl = url;
            lastCache = "MISS";
        }
        // 3. CACHE-FIRST: writer fills (resume-aware, proven path), waiter plays
        // local snapshot as soon as the first chunk lands. Never streams.
        final Context ac = c;
        new Thread(() -> {
            SongCache.download(ac, vid, url, total);
            // best-effort artwork, never fails audio
            try {
                JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(ac, vid);
                if (rec != null && !rec.has("artworkFile")) {
                    SongCache.fetchArtwork(ac, vid, rec.optString("artworkUrl", ""));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }).start();
        // initial need = first TWO chunks (prepare needs real clusters now).
        // Playback goes through the local proxy (never a frozen snapshot),
        // so no snapshot copy here: register the live file and start.
        long oneChunk = SongCache.chunkEndFor(0, (int) r.durationMs, total);
        long need = Math.min(total, 2 * oneChunk);
        if (!waitForBytes(ac, vid, need, gen, total)) return;
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen) return;
        }
        java.io.File live = SongCache.isComplete(ac, vid)
                ? SongCache.audioFile(ac, vid) : SongCache.partFile(ac, vid);
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen) return;
            playFile = live.getAbsolutePath();
        }
        nlog("[CACHE] prefix ready videoId=" + vid + " bytes=" + live.length());
        // BUG B: carry the ENGINE_SWITCH resume offset into the window and
        // the prepare-seek (startPathAt would otherwise reset it to 0).
        // Clamped to metadata duration; onPrepared clamps again vs actual.
        final int startAt;
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen) return;
            int durCap = r.durationMs > 0 && r.durationMs < Integer.MAX_VALUE
                    ? (int) r.durationMs : Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            startAt = Math.max(0, Math.min(pendingStartMs, durCap));
            setWindow(vid, url, total, startAt, (int) r.durationMs, ac);
        }
        startPathAt(live.getAbsolutePath(), Source.CACHED_AUDIO, ac, gen, startAt);
    }

    /**
     * Wait (off main thread) until localBytes >= need or terminal condition.
     * Terminal: gen stale, stop, record FAILED, or no progress for TIMEOUT_MS
     * (reuses SongCache timeout, no new watchdog). Returns true when playable.
     */
    private boolean waitForBytes(Context c, String vid, long need, int gen, long total) {
        long lastSeen = -1;
        long lastMoveAt = System.currentTimeMillis();
        for (;;) {
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (gen != playGen) return false;
                if (state == State.STOPPED || state == State.IDLE || state == State.ERROR) return false;
            }
            if (SongCache.hasBytes(c, vid, need)) return true;
            try {
                JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(c, vid);
                if (rec != null
                        && SongCache.ST_FAILED.equals(rec.optString("cacheStatus", ""))) {
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        if (gen != playGen) return false;
                        failLocked(rec.optString("failReason", "cache-failed"), "fill failed");
                    }
                    pushAll();
                    return false;
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            long have = SongCache.localBytes(c, vid);
            long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
            if (have != lastSeen) {
                lastSeen = have;
                lastMoveAt = now;
            } else if (now - lastMoveAt > SongCache.TIMEOUT_MS
                    && !SongCache.isDownloading(vid)) {
                synchronized (lock) {
                    if (gen != playGen) return false;
                    failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_TIMEOUT, "fill stalled");
                }
                pushAll();
                return false;
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(250);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    /**
     * Sliding chunk window: chunk containing curMs, configurable prefetch ahead, hard stop.
     * Chunk size derived from SongCache (follows the 100KB const, no dup).
     * Enforced from the 4 triggers only: play start, chunk cross (tick),
     * seek-refill, track change. No timer, no polling thread.
     */
    private int chunkIdxForPos(int curMs, int durMs, long total) {
        long one = SongCache.chunkEndFor(0, durMs, total);
        if (one <= 0 || total <= 0 || durMs <= 0 || curMs <= 0) return 0;
        long need = total * (long) curMs / durMs;
        long idx = need / one;
        return idx > 1000000L ? 1000000 : (int) idx;
    }

    private long windowEndForPos(int curMs, int durMs, long total) {
        long one = SongCache.chunkEndFor(0, durMs, total);
        if (one <= 0) return total;
        long edge = SongCache.chunkEndFor(curMs, durMs, total);
        if (edge <= 0) return total;
        return Math.min(total, edge + CHUNK_WINDOW_SIZE * one);
    }

    /** Set window for a position; (re)starts resume-aware writer when behind. */
    private void setWindow(String vid, String url, long total, int curMs,
            int durMs, Context ac) {
        // windowEnd = playback + cacheAhead. Itu saja: tanpa clamp, tanpa
        // boost. Reader yang menunggu di depan window dilayani saat playback
        // maju menggeser window (chunk-cross) — bukan dengan memajukan
        // window ke posisi reader (boros kuota).
        windowChunk = chunkIdxForPos(curMs, durMs, total);
        windowEnd = windowEndForPos(curMs, durMs, total);
        long have = 0;
        try {
            if (ac != null) have = SongCache.localBytes(ac, vid);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        nlog("[NAE] window set chunk=" + windowChunk + " end=" + windowEnd
                + " curMs=" + curMs + " total=" + total + " writerState="
                + (SongCache.isDownloading(vid) ? "RUNNING" : (SongCache.isFull(vid) ? "COMPLETE" : "IDLE")));
        nlog("[NAE-WINDOW] setWindow playChunk=" + windowChunk
                + " cacheAhead=" + CHUNK_WINDOW_SIZE + " windowEnd=" + windowEnd
                + " have=" + have);
        if (ac == null || total <= 0) return;
        // SIMPLE: tanpa guard writer, tanpa start/restart writer di sini.
        // Writer hidup independen sejak play (resolve flow) dan loop dengan
        // cap dari getCurrentWindowEnd. setWindow murni aritmetika window.
    }

    private void startPath(String path, Source src, Context c) {        synchronized (lock) {
            prepareLocked();
            source = src;
            setStateLocked(State.BUFFERING);
            nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=" + src
                    + " data=file videoId=" + videoId);
            try {
                mp.setDataSource(path);
                mp.prepareAsync();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "setDataSource file " + e);
            }
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    /** Lazy local proxy; null when it fails (caller falls back to file path). */
    private LocalStreamServer ensureServer(Context c) {
        // FASE 2F: this proxy is MediaPlayer-only. Exo mode exits through
        // startPathAt's GrowingFileDataSource branch before registration.
        // Keep LSS alive for the legacy fallback path.
        if (streamServer != null) return streamServer;
        try {
            Context ac = c != null ? c.getApplicationContext() : appCtx;
            if (ac == null) return null;
            LocalStreamServer s = new LocalStreamServer(ac);
            s.start(10000, true);
            streamServer = s;
            nlog("[ENGINE] local proxy port=" + s.port());
            return s;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            nlog("[ENGINE] proxy start FAIL " + e + " -> file fallback");
            streamServer = null;
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Window source untuk writer loop (SongCache): windowEnd terkini
     *  track ini, -1 bila bukan track aktif. */
    public static long getCurrentWindowEnd(String vid) {
        final NativeAudioEngine engine = INSTANCE;
        if (engine == null || vid == null || vid.isEmpty()) return -1;
        synchronized (engine.lock) {
            if (!vid.equals(engine.videoId)) return -1;
            return engine.windowEnd;
        }
    }

    /** Force-advance chunk window on LSS hold timeout (called from proxy thread). */
    /** H1: reader HOLD entry wakes the writer in ANY state. */
    private void onReaderHold(String vid, long pos, long have) {
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (!exoMode || !vid.equals(videoId)) return;
            nlog("[NAE] readerHold videoId=" + vid + " pos=" + pos
                    + " have=" + have + " state=" + state + " -> wakeWriter");
        }
        requestWindowAdvance(vid, "readerHold");
    }

    public static void requestWindowAdvance(String vid) {
        requestWindowAdvance(vid, "demand");
    }

    /** Origin-tagged window re-drive (B4 logs the readerHold trigger).
     *  Basis = playback + cacheAhead, sama seperti tick. H1 hanya wake
     *  writer; tidak boost windowEnd ke posisi reader. */
    public static void requestWindowAdvance(String vid, String origin) {
        final NativeAudioEngine engine = INSTANCE;
        if (vid == null || vid.isEmpty()) return;
        engine.timer.post(() -> {
            synchronized (engine.lock) {
                if (!vid.equals(engine.videoId)) return;
                if (engine.lastTotal <= 0 || engine.durationMs <= 0 || engine.appCtx == null) return;
                if (engine.state == State.IDLE || engine.state == State.STOPPED
                        || engine.state == State.ERROR || engine.state == State.ENDED) return;
                int cur = engine.currentMs;
                try {
                    if (engine.exoMode && engine.exo != null) {
                        cur = (int) engine.exo.currentPositionMs();
                    } else if (engine.mp != null) {
                        cur = engine.mp.getCurrentPosition();
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                engine.setWindow(vid, engine.lastUrl, engine.lastTotal, cur,
                        engine.durationMs, engine.appCtx);
                if ("readerHold".equals(origin)) {
                    nlog("[NAE] window set from readerHold chunk=" + engine.windowChunk
                            + " end=" + engine.windowEnd + " videoId=" + vid);
                } else {
                    nlog("[NAE] window advance on demand videoId=" + vid);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /** FASE 2: Exo streaming (placeholder URL; ResolvingDataSource isi
     *  https asli per open). Tanpa writer, tanpa window, tanpa proxy. */
    /** FASE 3 Fix1: transient JS queue mirror (playlist builder only). */
    static final class TrackRef {
        String id = "";
        String title = "";
        String artist = "";
        String art = "";
    }
    private final java.util.List<TrackRef> queue = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
    private int queueIndex = 0;

    /** JS owner queue; native simpan mirror tiap play untuk bangun playlist. */
    public void setQueue(String jsonQueue, int currentIndex) {
        final java.util.List<TrackRef> next = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try {
            org.json.JSONArray arr = new org.json.JSONArray(
                    jsonQueue != null ? jsonQueue : "[]");
            for (int i = 0; i < arr.length(); i++) {
                org.json.JSONObject o = arr.optJSONObject(i);
                if (o == null) continue;
                TrackRef t = new TrackRef();
                t.id = o.optString("videoId", "");
                t.title = o.optString("title", "");
                t.artist = o.optString("artist", "");
                t.art = o.optString("thumbnail", "");
                if (!t.id.isEmpty()) next.add(t);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        synchronized (lock) {
            queue.clear();
            queue.addAll(next);
            queueIndex = Math.max(0, currentIndex);
        }
        nlog("[QUEUE] mirror size=" + next.size() + " index=" + currentIndex);
    }

    private void startExoUrl(String url, String vid, int gen, int startMs) {
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen || !vid.equals(videoId)) return;
            consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
            lastRecoveryAttemptMs = 0;
            pendingStartMs = Math.max(0, startMs);
            prepareLocked();
            seeking = false;
            source = Source.VISIONOS;
            playFile = url;
            setStateLocked(State.BUFFERING);
            if (!exoMode || exo == null) {
                failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "exo backend gone");
                pushAll();
                return;
            }
            nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=VISIONOS data=https backend=exo"
                    + " gen=" + gen + " startMs=" + pendingStartMs
                    + " videoId=" + videoId);
            final Context actx = appCtx;
            final String v = videoId;
            final String t = title;
            final int at = pendingStartMs;
            final java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            int startIndex = 0;
            for (TrackRef q : queue) ids.add(q.id);
            if (ids.isEmpty()) {
                ids.add(v);
            } else {
                for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
                    if (v.equals(ids.get(i))) {
                        startIndex = i;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            final java.util.List<String> fids = ids;
            final int fidx = startIndex;
            nlog("[QUEUE] playlist size=" + fids.size() + " startIndex=" + fidx);
            exo.play(actx, v, t, at, url, fids, fidx);
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    /** startPath with generation + start offset (initial fill and seek-refill share it). */
    private void startPathAt(String path, Source src, Context c, int gen, int startMs) {
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (gen != playGen) return;
            consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
            lastRecoveryAttemptMs = 0;
            pendingStartMs = Math.max(0, startMs);
            prepareLocked();
            seeking = false;
            source = src;
            playFile = path;
            setStateLocked(State.BUFFERING);
            if (exoMode && exo != null) {
                // FASE 2 OPSI C: no LSS proxy; GrowingFileDataSource reads the
                // live .part/.webm directly (blocking, never truncating).
                nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=" + src
                        + " data=growing-file backend=exo"
                        + " gen=" + gen + " startMs=" + pendingStartMs
                        + " videoId=" + videoId);
                final Context actx = appCtx != null ? appCtx : c;
                final String v = videoId;
                final String t = title;
                final int at = pendingStartMs;
                exo.play(actx, v, t, at);
            } else {
                // Serve through the local proxy so a growing file never looks
                // truncated: the proxy holds Range reads until bytes land.
                // FASE 2F: LSS remains fallback-only; Exo reads .part directly.
                String ds = path;
            try {
                LocalStreamServer srv = ensureServer(appCtx != null ? appCtx : c);
                if (srv != null && lastTotal > 0) {
                    srv.register(videoId, path, lastTotal);
                    ds = "http://127.0.0.1:" + srv.port() + "/local-stream/" + videoId;
                    nlog("[ENGINE] proxy serve videoId=" + videoId);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=" + src
                    + " data=" + (ds.startsWith("http") ? "proxy" : "file")
                    + " gen=" + gen + " startMs=" + pendingStartMs
                    + " videoId=" + videoId);
            try {
                if (ds.startsWith("http")) {
                    mp.setDataSource(appCtx != null ? appCtx : c, Uri.parse(ds));
                } else {
                    mp.setDataSource(ds);
                }
                mp.prepareAsync();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "setDataSource file " + e);
            }
            } // else mediaplayer (exo branch above skips LSS + MediaPlayer)
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    private void startUrl(String url, Source src) {
        // BOTTOM FALLBACK ONLY (cache-first bypass): total<=0, chunking impossible.
        nlog("[ENGINE] BOTTOM-FALLBACK stream (cache-first bypassed) videoId=" + videoId);
        synchronized (lock) {
            consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
            lastRecoveryAttemptMs = 0;
            prepareLocked();
            source = src;
            setStateLocked(State.BUFFERING);
            nlog("[ENGINE] logical=NATIVE source=" + src
                    + " data=stream videoId=" + videoId);
            try {
                Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
                headers.put("User-Agent",
                        "com.google.visionos.youtube/1.02(RealityDevice14,1; U; CPU visionOS 25_6_0 like Mac OS X; US)");
                mp.setDataSource(appCtx, android.net.Uri.parse(url), headers);
                mp.prepareAsync();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "setDataSource url " + e);
            }
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    /** Shared genuine-EOS path: mark ENDED (unless an ERROR already won) and push. */
    private void fireGenuineEnd(android.media.MediaPlayer p, long pos, long dur) {
        int cur = currentMs;
        try {
            cur = p.getDuration();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, cur, "MediaPlayer.onCompletion");
    }

    /** Backend-agnostic genuine-EOS core (MediaPlayer + ExoPlayer share it). */
    private void fireGenuineEndAt(long pos, long dur, int curMs, String reason) {
        synchronized (lock) {
            currentMs = curMs;
            if (state != State.ERROR) {
                nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] ENDED fired. reason=" + reason
                        + " currentMs=" + currentMs + " durationMs=" + durationMs
                        + " state=" + state + " videoId=" + videoId
                        + " writerState=" + writerState(videoId) + " bufferPos=n/a");
                setStateLocked(State.ENDED);
                nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] state=ENDED videoId=" + videoId);
            } else {
                // Genuine position but a racing ERROR (stall timeout /
                // FAILED record) already won: ENDED is suppressed and
                // only pushAll below carries the ERROR downstream.
                nlog("[ENGINE] genuine-suppressed state=ERROR reason=" + failReason
                        + " pos=" + pos + " dur=" + dur + " videoId=" + videoId);
            }
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    /**
     * FASE 2: exo backend setup (lock held). Mirrors the MediaPlayer listener
     * wiring below: raw player facts come in, the shared classify + anti-loop
     * + recovery chain (handlePlaybackEnd) owns every verdict.
     */
    private void prepareExoLocked() {
        if (exo != null) {
            try {
                exo.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            exo = null;
        }
        final ExoPlaybackEngine eng = new ExoPlaybackEngine();
        eng.setEndDelegate(new ExoPlaybackEngine.EndDelegate() {
            @Override public void onPlayerEnded(String vid, long pos,
                    long consumed, long avail) {
                onExoEnded(vid, pos, consumed, avail);
            }

            @Override public void onPlaylistAdvanced(String nid) {
                onExoPlaylistAdvanced(nid);
            }

            @Override public void onPlayerStalled(String vid, long pos) {
                // FASE 2 watchdog re-arm: 3s freeze while READY+playing means
                // the window starved the reader; re-drive setWindow
                // (idempotent on same chunk) instead of waiting for LSS hold.
                nlog("[WATCHDOG] exo stall pos=" + pos + " videoId=" + vid
                        + " (re-driving window)");
                requestWindowAdvance(vid);
            }

            @Override public void onSeekDone(String vid, long pos) {
                synchronized (lock) {
                    if (!vid.equals(videoId)) return;
                    currentMs = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
                    nlog("[MSESSION] seek sync videoId=" + vid + " posMs=" + currentMs);
                }
                synchronized (lock) {
                    if (!vid.equals(videoId)) return;
                    seeking = false;
                    currentMs = (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
                    if (state == State.SEEKING) {
                        setStateLocked(exoWasPlaying ? State.PLAYING : State.PAUSED);
                    }
                    nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] seekDone backend=exo cur=" + (currentMs / 1000.0));
                }
                pushAll();
            }

            @Override public void onEngineError(String vid, String reason, long pos) {
                synchronized (lock) {
                    if (!vid.equals(videoId)) return;
                    nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] ExoPlayer.onError reason=" + reason
                            + " pos=" + pos + " videoId=" + vid + " state=" + state);
                    failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "exo " + reason);
                }
                pushAll();
            }

            @Override public void onPlayerState(String vid, int exoState,
                    boolean isPlaying) {
                onExoPlayerState(vid, exoState, isPlaying);
            }
        });
        exo = eng;
        // H1: reader HOLD wakes the writer through the existing window path,
        // in ANY native state (closes the BUFFERING liveness gap).
        eng.setHoldListener((v, p, h) -> onReaderHold(v, p, h));
        try {
            if (appCtx != null) {
                // Exo mode owns transport through MediaSessionService. Stop
                // legacy service directly; PlaybackService.stop() delegates
                // back to this engine when the Exo flag is enabled.
                appCtx.stopService(new android.content.Intent(appCtx, PlaybackService.class));
                PlaybackMediaSessionService.ensureStarted(appCtx);
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            nlog("[EXO] MediaSession service start failed " + e);
        }
        eng.setAudioSessionListener(session -> timer.post(() -> {
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (exo == eng && exoMode && session > 0) {
                    applyVolumeLocked();
                }
            }
        }));
        // FASE 2C single-owner: ExoPlayer's AudioFocusManager
        // (handleAudioFocus=true) owns focus in exoMode. A second NAE
        // request creates a same-uid rival client that LOSSes the first
        // one (playback dead on arrival). Manual focus callbacks below
        // stay gated to the MediaPlayer path.
        applyVolumeLocked();
        acquireWakeLock();
        nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] backend=exo prepared videoId=" + videoId);
    }

    /** Raw ExoPlayer end -> shared classification (main thread). */
    /**
     * FASE 3 Fix1: player pindah item playlist sendiri (gapless advance).
     * Sinkron videoId/meta dari queue mirror + push ke JS (JS geser index,
     * tanpa restart engine). Manual next/prev tetap via JS.
     */
    private void onExoPlaylistAdvanced(String nid) {
        if (nid == null || nid.isEmpty()) return;
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (!exoMode) return;
            if (nid.equals(videoId)) return;
            TrackRef found = null;
            for (TrackRef q : queue) {
                if (nid.equals(q.id)) {
                    found = q;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (found == null) return;
            videoId = found.id;
            if (!found.title.isEmpty()) title = found.title;
            if (!found.artist.isEmpty()) artist = found.artist;
            if (!found.art.isEmpty()) artwork = found.art;
            currentMs = 0;
            durationMs = 0;
            pendingStartMs = 0;
            lastCache = "MISS";
            nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] playlist advance videoId=" + videoId);
        }
        pushAll();
        pushEvent("playlistAdvanced", nid);
    }

    private void onExoEnded(String vid, long pos, long consumed, long avail) {
        long dur;
        long playerDur;
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (!vid.equals(videoId)) return;
            if (state == State.STOPPED || state == State.IDLE) return;
            long exoDur = -1L;
            try {
                if (exo != null) exoDur = exo.playerDurationMs();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (exoDur > 0) {
                durationMs = (int) Math.min(exoDur, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            }
            dur = durationMs;
            playerDur = exoDur;
            nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] ExoPlayer.ended pos=" + pos + " duration=" + dur
                    + " videoId=" + vid + " writerState=" + writerState(vid));
        }
        handlePlaybackEnd(pos, dur, playerDur, consumed, avail, "ExoPlayer.ended");
    }

    /**
     * FASE 2 state mirroring: raw ExoPlayer facts -> native state machine.
     * Mapping lives in ExoStateMirror (pure, unit-tested). Rules:
     * - exoMode + same videoId only; MediaPlayer path never reaches here.
     * - ENDED ignored: onExoEnded owns it via the shared classify chain
     *   (premature vs genuine); a blind ENDED here would auto-next
     *   unfinished tracks.
     * - SEEKING ignored: onSeekDone owns the restore (exoWasPlaying).
     * - Terminal states (IDLE/STOPPED/ERROR/ENDED) ignored: release/stop/
     *   fail already own them; stray IDLE from async release must not
     *   resurrect the machine.
     * - No-op when the mapped state equals current (pause()/resume() set
     *   it first; the echo callback must not spam pushAll).
     * - Every real change pushAll()s to JS; PLAYING re-arms tick() (500ms
     *   timeUpdate + window + watchdog) via setStateLocked.
     */
    private void onExoPlayerState(String vid, int exoState, boolean isPlaying) {
        final State target;
        ExoStateMirror.Mapped m = ExoStateMirror.map(exoState, isPlaying);
        if (m == ExoStateMirror.Mapped.ENDED_NOT_MAPPED) return;
        switch (m) {
            case IDLE: target = State.IDLE; break;
            case BUFFERING: target = State.BUFFERING; break;
            case PLAYING: target = State.PLAYING; break;
            case PAUSED: target = State.PAUSED; break;
            default: return;
        }
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (!exoMode) return;
            if (!vid.equals(videoId)) return;
            if (seeking || state == State.SEEKING) return;
            if (state == State.IDLE || state == State.STOPPED
                    || state == State.ERROR || state == State.ENDED) return;
            if (state == target) return;
            if (state == State.RESOLVING
                    && (target == State.PLAYING || target == State.PAUSED
                        || target == State.IDLE)) return;
            setStateLocked(target);
            if (target == State.PLAYING) acquireWakeLock();
            else if (target == State.PAUSED) releaseWakeLock();
            nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] mirror exoState=" + exoState
                    + " isPlaying=" + isPlaying + " -> " + target
                    + " videoId=" + vid);
        }
        pushAll();
    }

    private void prepareLocked() {
        releaseLocked();
        if (exoMode) {
            prepareExoLocked();
            return;
        }
        mp = new MediaPlayer();
        try {
            mp.setAudioAttributes(new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
                    .build());
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        mp.setOnPreparedListener(p -> {
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (state != State.BUFFERING) return;
                durationMs = 0;
                try {
                    durationMs = p.getDuration();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                currentMs = 0;
                requestAudioFocus();
                try {
                    p.start();
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR, "start threw " + e);
                    pushAll();
                    return;
                }
                if (pendingStartMs > 0) {
                    try {
                        int at = durationMs > 0
                                ? Math.min(pendingStartMs, durationMs) : pendingStartMs;
                        p.seekTo(at);
                        currentMs = at;
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    pendingStartMs = 0;
                }
                setStateLocked(State.PLAYING);
                applyVolumeLocked();
                acquireWakeLock();
                nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] state=PLAYING videoId=" + videoId
                        + " duration=" + (durationMs / 1000.0));
            }
            pushAll();
        });

        mp.setOnCompletionListener(p -> {
            long pos;
            long dur;
            long playerDur;
            synchronized (lock) {
                int callbackPosition = -1;
                int callbackDuration = -1;
                try { callbackPosition = p.getCurrentPosition(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                try { callbackDuration = p.getDuration(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] MediaPlayer.onCompletion fired. currentPosition="
                        + callbackPosition + " duration=" + callbackDuration
                        + " videoId=" + videoId + " writerState=" + writerState(videoId));
                pos = callbackPosition;
                dur = durationMs > 0 ? durationMs : callbackDuration;
                playerDur = callbackDuration;
            }
            // MediaPlayer marks unknown (-1): the shared chain reads LSS/estimate.
            handlePlaybackEnd(pos, dur, playerDur, -1L, -1L, "MediaPlayer.onCompletion");
        });

        mp.setOnErrorListener((p, what, extra) -> {
            synchronized (lock) {
                nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] MediaPlayer.onError what=" + what + " extra=" + extra
                        + " currentPosition=" + safePosition(p) + " duration=" + safeDuration(p)
                        + " videoId=" + videoId + " state=" + state
                        + " writerState=" + writerState(videoId));
                failLocked(VisionOsResolver.R_MEDIA_ERROR,
                        "mediaplayer what=" + what + " extra=" + extra);
            }
            pushAll();
            return true;
        });
        mp.setOnSeekCompleteListener(p -> {
            synchronized (lock) {
                seeking = false;
                try {
                    currentMs = p.getCurrentPosition();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                if (state == State.SEEKING) {
                    setStateLocked(wasPlayingBeforeSeek ? State.PLAYING : State.PAUSED);
                }
                nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] seekDone cur=" + (currentMs / 1000.0));
            }
            pushAll();
        });
        mp.setOnBufferingUpdateListener((p, pct) -> {
            nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] buffering pct=" + pct + " videoId=" + videoId);
            pushEvent("bufferingChanged", pct);
        });
        wasPlayingBeforeSeek = false; // reset per track; real value captured in seek()
    }

    /**
     * FASE 2: shared playback-end classifier for both backends.
     * Extracted byte-identical from the MediaPlayer onCompletion above: Fix A
     * complete-file genuine, Fix B player-duration bound, byte-range EOS +
     * BUG A guard, epsilon genuine, same-spot anti-loop (N=2, give-up x4 with
     * byte data), premature-resume, debounce + recovery.
     * ExoPlayer passes DataSource marks (exo-ds, OPSI C); MediaPlayer passes
     * -1 and the LSS/estimate fallback below applies.
     */
    private void handlePlaybackEnd(long pos, long dur, long playerDur,
            long exoConsumed, long exoAvailable, String origin) {
            long epsilon = 3000;
            // Complete-file EOS is the real end even if metadata durationMs
            // overshoots (audio streams often run shorter than video
            // lengthSeconds): misclassifying it as premature routes to
            // firePrematureError, whose ERROR state never auto-nexts, so the
            // queue stops dead. Incomplete files keep the tight epsilon.
            boolean fileComplete = false;
            try {
                // isComplete = record COMPLETE + file present + size match.
                // (isFull is only the explicit "Download offline" job flag,
                // so it stays false for regular VisionOS playback.)
                // onCompletion has no Context param; appCtx is set in play().
                // Null appCtx -> keep the tight epsilon (fail-safe).
                if (appCtx != null) fileComplete = SongCache.isComplete(appCtx, videoId);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            if (fileComplete) epsilon = 15000;
            // Fix A: a COMPLETE file hitting EOF ended for real (audio
            // exhausted), whatever the metadata-duration skew. Epsilon
            // widening cannot cover tens-of-seconds overshoot, so skip the
            // premature path entirely for complete files.
            if (fileComplete) {
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] complete-file EOS genuine pos=" + pos + " dur=" + dur);
                fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, curMsFor(playerDur, pos), origin);
                return;
            }
            // Fix B (defensive): bound classification by the player's own
            // duration reading. If the container declares the full video
            // length while the audio ends early, getDuration() at EOF can
            // reflect the shorter reality — classify against the smaller
            // value. Guarded against <= 0 (header not ready).
            long effDur = dur;
            if (playerDur > 0 && playerDur < effDur - 5000) {
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] player duration shorter, using playerDur=" + playerDur
                        + " vs dur=" + effDur);
                effDur = playerDur;
            }
            // Byte-range primary: EOF with everything available already
            // consumed means the audible data is exhausted, whatever metadata
            // claims. consumed = LSS served mark (A); else linear byte
            // estimate from pos (B). Anti-loop below stays as safety net.
            long consumedBytes = -1;
            String consumedSrc = "none";
            if (exoConsumed > 0) {
                // FASE 2 OPSI C: DataSource read count (never LSS, never estimate).
                consumedBytes = exoConsumed;
                consumedSrc = "exo-ds";
            } else {
                try {
                    if (streamServer != null) {
                        long served = streamServer.servedBytes(videoId);
                        if (served > 0) {
                            consumedBytes = served;
                            consumedSrc = "lss";
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                if (consumedBytes <= 0 && pos >= 0 && dur > 0 && lastTotal > 0) {
                    consumedBytes = lastTotal * (long) pos / dur;
                    if (consumedBytes > 0) consumedSrc = "estimate";
                }
            }
            long availableBytes = -1;
            try {
                if (appCtx != null) availableBytes = SongCache.localBytes(appCtx, videoId);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            long byteThreshold = availableBytes > 0 ? availableBytes - SongCache.chunkBytes() : -1;
            // BUG A guard: byte-exhaustion only proves EOS when no more data
            // can ever arrive. A PAUSED/partial file starving the reader is
            // a buffer underrun (writer idle at quota or stalled) — premature,
            // giving download+recovery a chance instead of auto-skipping.
            // (fileComplete already returned genuine above via Fix A.)
            boolean byteEos = fileComplete && SongCache.isByteRangeEos(consumedBytes, availableBytes,
                    SongCache.chunkBytes());
            nlog("[ENGINE] byte-range EOS: consumed=" + consumedBytes + "(" + consumedSrc + ")"
                    + " available=" + availableBytes + " threshold=" + byteThreshold
                    + " verdict=" + (byteEos ? "genuine" : "premature"));
            if (byteEos) {
                fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, curMsFor(playerDur, pos), origin);
                return;
            }
            if (effDur > 0 && pos >= effDur - epsilon) {
                // Genuine end
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Genuine onCompletion: pos=" + pos + " dur=" + dur);
                fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, curMsFor(playerDur, pos), origin);
                return;
            }
            // Same-spot count (shared by anti-loop and byte-stall give-up).
            // A repeat at +-1000ms is deterministic, not a transient glitch.
            int sameSpotCount = 0;
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (lastPrematurePosMs >= 0 && Math.abs(pos - lastPrematurePosMs) <= 1000) {
                    lastPrematureSameCount++;
                } else {
                    lastPrematurePosMs = pos;
                    lastPrematureSameCount = 1;
                }
                sameSpotCount = lastPrematureSameCount;
            }
            boolean byteRangeAvailable = consumedBytes > 0 && availableBytes > 0;
            if (byteRangeAvailable && !byteEos) {
                // FASE 2: byte-range says data remains — its premature verdict
                // outranks anti-loop. Skipping here would drop a song that has
                // not finished (LmzirvMDOP4 @62%).
                if (sameSpotCount >= SAME_SPOT_GIVE_UP) {
                    Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] byte-stall give-up x" + sameSpotCount
                            + " at pos=" + pos + ": treating as genuine EOS");
                    fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, curMsFor(playerDur, pos), origin);
                    return;
                }
                nlog("[ENGINE] byte-range premature wins, anti-loop skipped"
                        + " pos=" + pos + " sameSpot=x" + sameSpotCount);
                // FASE 3: resume an idle writer so the starving reader gets
                // more bytes (quota already served its purpose). Guarded:
                // incomplete record, idle writer, known url/total, same gen.
                // Falls through to normal premature recovery below.
                try {
                    String resumeUrl;
                    long resumeTotal;
                    int resumeGen;
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        resumeUrl = lastUrl;
                        resumeTotal = lastTotal;
                        resumeGen = playGen;
                    }
                    boolean incomplete = true;
                    if (appCtx != null) {
                        try {
                            org.json.JSONObject rec = SongCache.getRecord(appCtx, videoId);
                            incomplete = rec == null
                                    || !SongCache.ST_COMPLETE.equals(rec.optString("cacheStatus", ""));
                        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    }
                    boolean sameGen;
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        sameGen = (resumeGen == playGen);
                    }
                    if (incomplete && sameGen && resumeUrl != null && !resumeUrl.isEmpty()
                            && resumeTotal > 0 && appCtx != null
                            && !SongCache.isDownloading(videoId)) {
                        nlog("[CACHE] premature-resume videoId=" + videoId
                                + " have=" + availableBytes + " total=" + resumeTotal);
                        final android.content.Context fc = appCtx;
                        final String fu = resumeUrl;
                        final long ft = resumeTotal;
                        new Thread(() -> SongCache.download(fc, videoId, fu, ft)).start();
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            } else if (sameSpotCount >= 2) {
                // Byte data unavailable: original anti-loop (durEos fallback
                // cases). 1st hit keeps its fair recovery chance.
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] same-spot premature x" + sameSpotCount
                        + " at pos=" + pos + ": treating as genuine EOS");
                fireGenuineEndAt(pos, dur, curMsFor(playerDur, pos), origin);
                return;
            }
            // Premature completion: debounce loop, then recover on worker thread
            // (blocking prepare must never run on the callback thread).
            final long lastMs = pos;
            final long trackDur = dur;
            final String recVid;
            final int recGen;
            final String recDs;
            final int recCount;
            final boolean recExo;
            synchronized (lock) {
                long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
                if (now - lastRecoveryAttemptMs < RECOVERY_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
                    consecutiveRecoveryCount++;
                } else {
                    consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
                }
                lastRecoveryAttemptMs = now;
                if (consecutiveRecoveryCount > MAX_CONSECUTIVE_RECOVERIES) {
                    Log.e(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery loop detected, giving up. Firing error.");
                    consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
                    firePrematureError(pos, playerDur > 0 ? playerDur : dur, "RECOVERY_LOOP");
                    return;
                }
                recCount = consecutiveRecoveryCount;
                recVid = videoId;
                recGen = playGen;
                recExo = exoMode;
                if (streamServer != null && lastTotal > 0) {
                    recDs = "http://127.0.0.1:" + streamServer.port() + "/local-stream/" + videoId;
                } else {
                    recDs = playFile;
                }
                recoveryAttempts = 0;
                lastRecoveryStatus = "attempting";
            }
            double pct = trackDur > 0 ? (100.0 * lastMs / trackDur) : 0;
            Log.e(TAG, "[ENGINE] Premature onCompletion: pos=" + lastMs + " dur=" + trackDur
                    + " (" + String.format("%.1f", pct) + "%) videoId=" + recVid
                    + " consecutive=" + recCount);
            pushRecoveryEvent("attempting", recVid, lastMs, trackDur, null);
            if (recExo) {
                // FASE 2 exo recovery: seekTo+play (no re-prepare), 4x budget,
                // then genuine. MediaPlayer path below untouched.
                new Thread(() -> attemptExoRecovery(recVid, recGen, lastMs, trackDur)).start();
                return;
            }
            final int skipSoft = recCount > 1 ? 1 : 0;
            new Thread(() -> attemptPrematureRecovery(recVid, recGen, recDs, lastMs, trackDur, skipSoft)).start();
    }

    /** currentMs value for genuine ends (player reading wins, pos fallback). */
    private static int curMsFor(long playerDur, long pos) {
        if (playerDur > 0) return (int) Math.min(playerDur, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        return (int) Math.max(0, Math.min(pos, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
    }

    private boolean wasPlayingBeforeSeek;

    private void stopLocked(String why) {
        timer.removeCallbacks(ticker);
        abandonAudioFocus();
        releaseWakeLock();
        try {
            if (streamServer != null) streamServer.unregister(videoId);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        releaseLocked();
        state = State.STOPPED;
        source = Source.NONE;
        seeking = false;
        currentMs = 0;
        nlog("[NATIVE_CMD] stop why=" + why + " videoId=" + videoId);
        // hand notification back to idle (WebView mirror resumes on next push)
        try {
            if (appCtx != null) PlaybackService.nativeReleased(appCtx);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void releaseLocked() {
        if (boostEnhancer != null) {
            try { boostEnhancer.release(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            boostEnhancer = null;
            enhancerSessionId = 0;
        }
        if (exo != null) {
            try {
                exo.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            exo = null;
        }
        if (mp != null) {
            try {
                mp.reset();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            try {
                mp.release();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            mp = null;
        }
    }

    private void failLocked(String reason, String msg) {
        timer.removeCallbacks(ticker);
        releaseWakeLock();
        releaseLocked();
        state = State.ERROR;
        failReason = reason;
        failMessage = msg;
        nlog("[FALLBACK] START reason=" + reason + " msg=" + msg
                + " videoId=" + videoId + " action=iFrame");
    }

    /** Terminal error for unrecovered premature completion: ERROR so JS never auto-nexts. */
    private void firePrematureError(long pos, long dur, String reason) {
        synchronized (lock) {
            lastRecoveryStatus = "failed";
            failLocked("PREMATURE_COMPLETION",
                    "pos=" + pos + " dur=" + dur + " reason=" + reason);
        }
        pushRecoveryEvent("failed", videoId, pos, dur, reason);
        pushAll();
    }

    /** Retry a prematurely-completed track from its last position (worker thread). */
    private void attemptPrematureRecovery(String recVid, int recGen, String recDs,
            long lastMs, long trackDur, int skipSoft) {
        // Phase 1: soft-seek with actual playback verification (p2 > p1).
        if (skipSoft <= 0) {
            try {
                try {
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || mp == null) return;
                        mp.seekTo((int) Math.max(0, lastMs));
                        mp.start();
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(500);
                    long p1;
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || mp == null) return;
                        p1 = mp.getCurrentPosition();
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(500);
                    long p2;
                    boolean playing;
                    synchronized (lock) {
                        if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || mp == null) return;
                        p2 = mp.getCurrentPosition();
                        try { playing = mp.isPlaying(); } catch (Exception ignored) { playing = false; }
                    }
                    if (playing && p2 > p1 && p2 >= lastMs - 500) {
                        synchronized (lock) {
                            currentMs = (int) p2;
                            setStateLocked(State.PLAYING);
                            consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
                            lastRecoveryStatus = "recovered";
                            acquireWakeLock();
                        }
                        Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery SUCCESS via soft-seek newPos=" + p2);
                        pushRecoveryEvent("recovered", recVid, lastMs, trackDur, "soft-seek");
                        pushAll();
                        return;
                    } else {
                        boolean pl;
                        synchronized (lock) {
                            boolean tmp = false;
                            try { tmp = mp != null && mp.isPlaying(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            pl = tmp;
                        }
                        Log.w(TAG, "[ENGINE] Soft recovery check failed: isPlaying=" + pl
                                + " p1=" + p1 + " p2=" + p2);
                        throw new Exception("soft recovery position did not advance");
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    if ("soft recovery position did not advance".equals(e.getMessage())) throw e;
                    throw e;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Soft-seek failed, falling back to hard recovery: " + e);
            }
        } else {
            Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Skipping soft recovery, consecutive=" + skipSoft);
        }
        // Phase 2: hard recovery, up to 3 attempts. Async prepare with a
        // one-shot OnPreparedListener (seek + start); no blocking sleep.
        String failReason = null;
        boolean recovered = false;
        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 3 && !recovered; attempt++) {
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId)) return;
                recoveryAttempts = attempt;
            }
            Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery attempt " + attempt + "/3 from pos=" + lastMs);
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || mp == null) return;
                try {
                    recoveryPrepared = false;
                    mp.reset();
                    if (recDs != null && recDs.startsWith("http") && appCtx != null) {
                        mp.setDataSource(appCtx, Uri.parse(recDs));
                    } else if (recDs != null && !recDs.isEmpty()) {
                        mp.setDataSource(recDs);
                    } else {
                        failReason = "no data source available for recovery";
                        continue;
                    }
                    final long seekTarget = Math.max(0, lastMs);
                    mp.setOnPreparedListener(p -> {
                        synchronized (lock) {
                            try { p.seekTo((int) seekTarget); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            try { p.start(); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                            recoveryPrepared = true;
                            lock.notifyAll();
                        }
                    });
                    mp.prepareAsync();
                    long deadline = System.currentTimeMillis() + 10000;
                    while (!recoveryPrepared) {
                        long waitMs = deadline - System.currentTimeMillis();
                        if (waitMs <= 0) break;
                        try {
                            lock.wait(waitMs);
                        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                            return;
                        }
                        if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId)) return;
                    }
                    if (!recoveryPrepared) {
                        failReason = "prepare timeout on attempt " + attempt;
                        continue;
                    }
                    boolean playingNow = false;
                    long newPos = -1;
                    try {
                        playingNow = mp.isPlaying();
                        newPos = mp.getCurrentPosition();
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                    if (playingNow && newPos >= lastMs - 500) {
                        recovered = true;
                        currentMs = (int) newPos;
                        setStateLocked(State.PLAYING);
                        lastRecoveryStatus = "recovered";
                        acquireWakeLock();
                        Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery SUCCESS at attempt " + attempt
                                + " newPos=" + newPos);
                    } else {
                        failReason = "position_not_advancing after attempt " + attempt;
                    }
                } catch (Exception e) {
                    failReason = e.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + e.getMessage();
                    Log.e(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery attempt " + attempt + " failed: " + failReason);
                }
            }
        }
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (mp != null) {
                try { mp.setOnPreparedListener(null); } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
        }
        if (recovered) {
            pushRecoveryEvent("recovered", recVid, lastMs, trackDur, null);
            pushAll();
        } else {
            Log.e(TAG, "[ENGINE] Recovery FAILED after 3 attempts. reason=" + failReason);
            firePrematureError(lastMs, trackDur, failReason);
        }
    }

    /**
     * FASE 2 exo recovery (worker thread): seekTo+play needs no re-prepare.
     * Budget from ExoRecoveryPolicy (4x); exhausted -> treat as genuine end
     * (bounded, never an infinite loop). Recovered event/state updates mirror
     * the MediaPlayer path above.
     */
    private void attemptExoRecovery(String recVid, int recGen, long lastMs, long trackDur) {
        ExoPlaybackEngine eng;
        synchronized (lock) {
            eng = exo;
        }
        if (eng == null) {
            firePrematureError(lastMs, trackDur, "exo-gone");
            return;
        }
        boolean recovered = false;
        String failReason = "unknown";
        while (eng.recoveryPolicy().consumeAttempt()) {
            int attempt = eng.recoveryPolicy().attemptsUsed();
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || exo == null) return;
            }
            Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Exo recovery attempt " + attempt + "/"
                    + ExoRecoveryPolicy.MAX_ATTEMPTS + " from pos=" + lastMs);
            try {
                eng.seekTo((int) Math.max(0, Math.min(lastMs, Integer.MAX_VALUE)));
                eng.resume();
            } catch (Exception e) {
                failReason = "seek threw " + e;
                continue;
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(700);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return;
            }
            long p1;
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || exo == null) return;
                p1 = eng.currentPositionMs();
            }
            try {
                Thread.sleep(700);
            } catch (InterruptedException e) {
                return;
            }
            long p2;
            boolean playing;
            synchronized (lock) {
                if (recGen != playGen || !recVid.equals(videoId) || exo == null) return;
                p2 = eng.currentPositionMs();
                playing = eng.isPlayingNow();
            }
            if (playing && p2 > p1 && p2 >= lastMs - 500) {
                synchronized (lock) {
                    currentMs = (int) Math.min(p2, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    setStateLocked(State.PLAYING);
                    consecutiveRecoveryCount = 0;
                    lastRecoveryStatus = "recovered";
                    acquireWakeLock();
                }
                Log.d(TAG, "[ENGINE] Exo recovery SUCCESS at attempt " + attempt
                        + " newPos=" + p2);
                recovered = true;
                break;
            }
            failReason = "position_not_advancing attempt=" + attempt + " p1=" + p1 + " p2=" + p2;
            Log.w(TAG, "[ENGINE] Exo recovery check failed: " + failReason);
        }
        if (recovered) {
            pushRecoveryEvent("recovered", recVid, lastMs, trackDur, "exo-seek");
            pushAll();
            return;
        }
        // Budget exhausted: treat as genuine (FASE 2 exo semantics).
        long epos = Math.max(0, eng.currentPositionMs());
        long edur = eng.playerDurationMs();
        if (edur <= 0) edur = trackDur;
        nlog("[ENGINE] Exo recovery budget exhausted x" + ExoRecoveryPolicy.MAX_ATTEMPTS
                + " at pos=" + epos + ": treating as genuine EOS");
        fireGenuineEndAt(epos, edur, (int) Math.min(epos, Integer.MAX_VALUE),
                "ExoPlayer.recovery-giveup");
    }

    /** Recovery lifecycle event for the WebView toast log. */
    private void pushRecoveryEvent(String status, String recVid, long pos, long dur,
            String reason) {
        try {
            JSONObject s;
            synchronized (lock) {
                s = snapshotLocked("recoveryStatus");
            }
            s.put("status", status);
            s.put("positionMs", pos);
            s.put("durationMs", dur);
            if (recVid != null) s.put("videoId", recVid);
            if (reason != null) s.put("reason", reason);
            final String js = "try{if(window.__nativeEvent)window.__nativeEvent("
                    + JSONObject.quote(s.toString()) + ");}catch(e){}";
            try {
                MainActivity a = MainActivity.current;
                if (a == null) return;
                a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
                    try {
                        android.webkit.WebView wv = a.getBridge() != null
                                ? a.getBridge().getWebView() : null;
                        if (wv != null) wv.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                });
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] " + s);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "[ENGINE] pushRecoveryEvent error: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private void setStateLocked(State s) {
        state = s;
        if (s == State.PLAYING) {
            timer.removeCallbacks(ticker);
            timer.postDelayed(ticker, 500);
            lastTickMs = System.currentTimeMillis();
        } else if (s != State.SEEKING) {
            timer.removeCallbacks(ticker);
        }
    }

    private void tick() {
        synchronized (lock) {
            if (state != State.PLAYING) return;
            if (exoMode) {
                if (exo == null) return;
                try {
                    long ep = exo.currentPositionMs();
                    if (ep >= 0) currentMs = (int) Math.min(ep, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    long ed = exo.playerDurationMs();
                    if (durationMs <= 0 && ed > 0) {
                        durationMs = (int) Math.min(ed, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            } else {
                if (mp == null) return;
                try {
                    currentMs = mp.getCurrentPosition();
                    if (durationMs <= 0) durationMs = mp.getDuration();
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            }
            long nowDiag = System.currentTimeMillis();
            if (nowDiag - lastDiagTickLog >= 2000) {
                lastDiagTickLog = nowDiag;
                nlog("[AUTONEXT_DIAG] tick currentMs=" + currentMs + " durationMs=" + durationMs
                        + " state=" + state + " writerState=" + writerState(videoId)
                        + " windowEnd=" + windowEnd + " windowChunk=" + windowChunk
                        );
            }
            pushEvent("timeUpdate", null);
            // SIMPLE: window update tiap 500ms, TANPA guard chunk-cross.
            // setWindow murni set windowChunk/windowEnd dari playback.
            try {
                if (lastTotal > 0 && durationMs > 0 && appCtx != null) {
                    setWindow(videoId, lastUrl, lastTotal, currentMs,
                            durationMs, appCtx);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            // notification progress (throttled: service updates cheap)
            try {
                if (appCtx != null) {
                    if (exoMode) {
                        PlaybackMediaSessionService.updateMetadata(appCtx, title, artist,
                                artwork, durationMs, currentMs);
                    } else {
                        PlaybackService.nativeProgress(appCtx, title, artist, artwork,
                                true, currentMs, durationMs);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            timer.postDelayed(ticker, 500);
        }
    }

    private JSONObject snapshotLocked(String event) {
        try {
            JSONObject o = new JSONObject();
            o.put("engine", "NATIVE");
            o.put("backend", exoMode ? "exo" : "mediaplayer");
            o.put("source", String.valueOf(source));
            o.put("state", String.valueOf(state));
            o.put("cache", lastCache);
            o.put("videoId", videoId);
            o.put("currentTime", currentMs / 1000.0);
            o.put("duration", durationMs / 1000.0);
            o.put("isBuffering", state == State.BUFFERING);
            o.put("bufferPct", bufferPercentLocked());
            o.put("windowSize", CHUNK_WINDOW_SIZE);
            o.put("title", title);
            o.put("artist", artist);
            o.put("artwork", artwork);
            if (event != null) o.put("event", event);
            if (failReason != null) o.put("reason", failReason);
            if (failMessage != null) o.put("message", failMessage);
            o.put("recoveryAttempts", recoveryAttempts);
            o.put("lastRecoveryStatus", lastRecoveryStatus != null ? lastRecoveryStatus : "");
            return o;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    private int bufferPercentLocked() {
        if (exoMode && exo != null && durationMs > 0) {
            try {
                long buffered = exo.bufferedPositionMs();
                long pos = exo.currentPositionMs();
                if (buffered >= 0 && pos >= 0) {
                    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100,
                            (int) Math.round(100d * Math.max(0, buffered - pos) / durationMs)));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        return state == State.BUFFERING ? 0 : 100;
    }

    private void pushAll() {
        // NOTE: pass the event NAME, not a prebuilt snapshot - pushEvent(null, snapshot)
        // silently drops the event field, so JS never refreshes the play/pause icon.
        pushEvent("playbackStateChanged", null);
        // notification follows native while active or just ended/errored
        try {
            if (appCtx != null) {
                if (exoMode) {
                    PlaybackMediaSessionService.updateMetadata(appCtx, title, artist,
                            artwork, durationMs, currentMs);
                } else {
                    PlaybackService.nativeProgress(appCtx, title, artist, artwork,
                            state == State.PLAYING, currentMs, durationMs);
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
    }

    private void pushEvent(String event, Object extra) {
        JSONObject s;
        synchronized (lock) {
            s = snapshotLocked(event);
        }
        if (extra instanceof Integer) {
            try {
                s.put("bufferPct", (Integer) extra);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        }
        final String js = "try{if(window.__nativeEvent)window.__nativeEvent("
                + JSONObject.quote(s.toString()) + ");}catch(e){}";
        try {
            MainActivity a = MainActivity.current;
            if (a == null) return;
            a.runOnUiThread(() -> {
                try {
                    android.webkit.WebView wv = a.getBridge() != null
                            ? a.getBridge().getWebView() : null;
                    if (wv != null) wv.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
                } catch (Exception ignored) {}
            });
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        // ADB mirror of every event
        nlog("[NATIVE_STATE] " + s);
    }

    private static long clenOf(String url) {
        try {
            String q = new java.net.URL(url).getQuery();
            if (q != null) {
                for (String kv : q.split("&")) {
                    int eq = kv.indexOf('=');
                    if (eq > 0 && kv.substring(0, eq).equals("clen")) {
                        return Long.parseLong(java.net.URLDecoder.decode(
                                kv.substring(eq + 1), "UTF-8"));
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {}
        return -1;
    }

    static void nlog(String m) {
        Log.d(TAG, m);
    }

    private static String writerState(String vid) {
        return SongCache.isDownloading(vid) ? "RUNNING"
                : (SongCache.isFull(vid) ? "COMPLETE" : "IDLE");
    }

    private static int safePosition(MediaPlayer player) {
        try { return player != null ? player.getCurrentPosition() : -1; }
        catch (Exception ignored) { return -1; }
    }

    private static int safeDuration(MediaPlayer player) {
        try { return player != null ? player.getDuration() : -1; }
        catch (Exception ignored) { return -1; }
    }
}

package com.dnialify.musicstream;

import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService;
import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification;

/** Ducks native playback when an outside notification with sound arrives. */
public class NotificationDuckService extends NotificationListenerService {
    private static NotificationDuckService instance;

    @Override
    public void onListenerConnected() {
        instance = this;
        Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] connected, instance assigned");
    }

    @Override
    public void onListenerDisconnected() {
        instance = null;
    }

    @Override
    public void onNotificationPosted(StatusBarNotification sbn) {
        Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] onNotificationPosted fired, pkg="
                + (sbn != null ? sbn.getPackageName() : "null"));
        if (sbn == null) {
            Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] SKIP reason=null_notification pkg=null");
            return;
        }
        if (sbn.getPackageName() == null) {
            Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] SKIP reason=null_package pkg=null");
            return;
        }
        String pkg = sbn.getPackageName();
        // Ignore our own notifications
        if ("com.dnialify.musicstream".equals(pkg)) {
            Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] SKIP reason=own_package pkg=" + pkg);
            return;
        }
        // Ignore ongoing / media notifications (they don't play sound)
        if (sbn.isOngoing()) {
            Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] SKIP reason=ongoing pkg=" + pkg);
            return;
        }

        // Duck
        Log.d("NDS", "[NDS] forwarding to engine: " + pkg);
        NativeAudioEngine.getInstance().onExternalNotification(sbn.getPackageName());
    }

    public static boolean isPermissionGranted() { return instance != null; }
}
