```javascript
    }
    const res = await fetchTimeout(def.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', headers: def.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx, videoId, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}`, vdAttached };
    const data = await res.json();
    const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
    const sd = data.streamingData;
    if (!sd) return { ok: false, error: `no streamingData playability=${ps.status}`, vdAttached };
    const formats = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])];
    const audios = formats.filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats', vdAttached };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}`, vdAttached, itag: best.itag };
    return {
      ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag, mime: best.mimeType,
      total: best.contentLength ? parseInt(best.contentLength, 10) : null,
      host: new URL(best.url).host, vdAttached,
      durSec: data.videoDetails?.lengthSeconds ? parseInt(data.videoDetails.lengthSeconds, 10) : null,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}`, vdAttached };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, {
      headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA },
    });
    const buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
    return { status: r.status, bytes: buf.byteLength, buf, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', bytes: 0, buf: null, ms: Date.now() - t0, err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

// 5-step ladder, 10s budget. Returns {step, buf, sub} or {step:0}.
async function ladder(video, byte, end, curUrl) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const budgetLeft = () => LADDER_BUDGET_MS - (Date.now() - t0);
  const tryUrl = async (u) => {
    const g = await getRange(u, byte, end);
    if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - byte + 1) return g.buf;
    return null;
  };
  // L1: same URL retry after 500ms
  if (budgetLeft() > 600) {
    await sleep(500);
    const b = await tryUrl(curUrl);
    if (b) return { step: 1, buf: b, sub: null, url: curUrl };
  }
  // L2: same client, same VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('VISIONOS', video, 'slot');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 2, buf: b, sub: null, host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L3: same client, fresh VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('VISIONOS', video, 'fresh');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 3, buf: b, sub: null, host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L4: fallback ANDROID
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('ANDROID', video, 'slot');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 4, buf: b, sub: 'ANDROID', host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  // L5: fallback ANDROID_VR + fresh VD
  if (budgetLeft() > 1500) {
    const r = await resolveClient('ANDROID_VR', video, 'fresh');
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      const b = await tryUrl(r.url);
      if (b) return { step: 5, buf: b, sub: 'ANDROID_VR', host: r.host, url: r.url };
    }
  }
  return { step: 0, buf: null, sub: null };
}

async function simSong(video, outDir) {

  if (!r.ok || !r.total || !r.durSec) {
    out.status = 'SIM_FAIL_RESOLVE';
    out.resolveError = r.error || 'no total/duration';

  }

  const durMs = r.durSec * 1000;
  out.total = total; out.durMs = durMs;
  const nChunks = Math.ceil(total / CHUNK);
  out.totalChunks = nChunks;
  const chunkDurMs = (CHUNK / total) * durMs;
  const idxOf = (playMs) => Math.min(nChunks - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor(playMs / chunkDurMs)));
  let url = r.url;
  const partFile = path.join(outDir, `${video}.part`);

  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(WINDOW, nChunks); i += 1) {

      writeChunk(i, g.buf);
    } else {
      if (g.status === 403) out.events403.push({ chunk: i, byte: g.start, playMs: 0, phase: 'init' });
      const lr = await ladder(video, g.start, g.end, url);

        if (lr.url) url = lr.url;
        out.recoveries.push({ chunk: i, step: lr.step, sub: lr.sub, host: lr.host || null });
        writeChunk(i, lr.buf);

        out.ms = Date.now() - t0wall;
        return out;
      }
    }

  const t0 = Date.now();
  let playMs = 0;
  let stallMs = 0;
  let stallRun = 0;
  let cacheFillMs = null;

    const tickStart = Date.now();

    const need = idxOf(expected);

      playMs = expected;
      stallRun = 0;
    } else {
      stallMs += TICK;

      out.totalStallMs += TICK;
      if (stallRun > out.gapMaxMs) out.gapMaxMs = stallRun;

        if (lr.step > 0) {
          if (lr.url) url = lr.url;

          out.recoveries.push({ chunk: idx, step: lr.step, sub: lr.sub, host: lr.host || null });
          writeChunk(idx, lr.buf);
        } else {
          broken = { atPlayMs: Math.round(playMs), chunk: idx, byte: g.start };
          break;
        }
      }
      if (have.size === nChunks && cacheFillMs === null) cacheFillMs = Date.now() - t0;
    }
    if (broken) break;
    if (playMs >= stopAt) break;
    if (Date.now() - t0 > durMs + 180000) { broken = { guard: 'timeout', atPlayMs: Math.round(playMs) }; break; }
    const spent = Date.now() - tickStart;
    if (spent < TICK) await sleep(TICK - spent);
  }
  fs.closeSync(fd);
  out.playMsEnd = Math.round(playMs);
  out.wallMs = Date.now() - t0;
  out.cacheFillMs = cacheFillMs;
  out.playbackFinished = !broken && playMs >= stopAt;
  try {
    out.fileIntact = fs.statSync(partFile).size === total && have.size === nChunks;
  } catch { out.fileIntact = false; }

    out.broken = broken;
  } else if (!out.playbackFinished) {
    out.status = 'SIM_INCOMPLETE';
  } else if (!out.fileIntact) {
    out.status = 'SIM_FILE_SHORT';
  } else if (out.gapMaxMs > STALL_OK_MAX) {

  } else {

}
```

```javascript
function seedOf(seed, song, client) {
  let h = seed >>> 0;
  const s = `${song}:${client}`;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += 1) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 2654435761);
  return h >>> 0;
}

async function fetchTimeout(url, opts = {}, ms = REQ_TIMEOUT_MS) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), ms);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: ctl.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(t);
  }
}

// per-client identity slots (never shared across clients)
const vdStore = { VISIONOS: null, ANDROID: null, ANDROID_VR: null };

async function fetchVd(name) {
  const def = CLIENTS[name];
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(def.context));
  delete ctx.client.visitorData;
  const res = await fetchTimeout(`${def.gapis}visitor_id?prettyPrint=false`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: def.headers, body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`visitor_id HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const vd = (await res.json())?.responseContext?.visitorData;
  if (!vd) throw new Error('visitor_id: no visitorData');
  vdStore[name] = vd;
  return vd;
}

// resolve with explicit visitorData policy; vd:'slot'|'fresh'|'invalid'|null
async function resolveClient(name, videoId, vdOpt) {
  const def = CLIENTS[name];
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(def.context));
  let vdAttached = false;
  try {
    if (vdOpt === 'invalid') {
      ctx.client.visitorData = `INVALID_EXPIRED_TEST_VD_${Date.now() % 100000}`;
      vdAttached = true;
    } else if (vdOpt === 'fresh') {
      ctx.client.visitorData = await fetchVd(name);
      vdAttached = true;
    } else if (vdOpt === 'slot') {
      if (!vdStore[name]) await fetchVd(name);
      if (def.useVd) { ctx.client.visitorData = vdStore[name]; vdAttached = true; }
    }
    const res = await fetchTimeout(def.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', headers: def.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx, videoId, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}`, vdAttached };
    const data = await res.json();
    const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
    const sd = data.streamingData;
    if (!sd) return { ok: false, error: `no streamingData playability=${ps.status} reason=${ps.reason || '-'}`, vdAttached, playability: ps.status };
    const formats = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])];
    const audios = formats.filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats', vdAttached, playability: ps.status };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}`, vdAttached, itag: best.itag, playability: ps.status };
    return {
      ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag, mime: best.mimeType, bitrate: best.bitrate,
      total: best.contentLength ? parseInt(best.contentLength, 10) : null,
      host: new URL(best.url).host, urlHash: hash8(best.url), vdAttached,
      playability: ps.status || 'OK',
      durSec: data.videoDetails?.lengthSeconds ? parseInt(data.videoDetails.lengthSeconds, 10) : null,
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}`, vdAttached };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end, extraHeaders) {
  const headers = { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA, ...(extraHeaders || {}) };
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, { headers });
    const buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
    return { status: r.status, bytes: buf.byteLength, buf,
      cr: r.headers.get('content-range') };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', bytes: 0, buf: null, cr: null, err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

function parseTotal(cr) {
  const m = cr && cr.match(/\/(\d+)\s*$/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : null;
}

function nextInChain(name, blacklist) {
  const i = CHAIN.indexOf(name);
  for (let k = 1; k <= CHAIN.length; k += 1) {
    const cand = CHAIN[(i + k) % CHAIN.length];
    if (!blacklist.has(cand)) return cand;
  }
  return null;
}

// ---------- SCENARIO A: strict baseline, production mirror (no retry/refresh) ----------
async function scenarioA(name, video, songDir) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = await resolveClient(name, video, 'slot');
  const out = { mode: 'A', client: name, video,
    resolve: r.ok ? { ok: true, itag: r.itag, host: r.host, urlHash: r.urlHash,
      vdAttached: r.vdAttached, total: r.total, durSec: r.durSec } : { ok: false, error: r.error },
    chunksOk: 0, http403: 0, failByte: null, cachedBytes: 0, status: null, ms: null, partFile: null };
  if (!r.ok || !r.total) { out.status = 'A_FAIL_RESOLVE'; out.ms = Date.now() - t0; return out; }
  const total = r.total;
  const partFile = path.join(songDir, `A_${name}.part`);
  out.partFile = partFile;
  const fd = fs.openSync(partFile, 'w');
  try {
    for (let start = 0; start < total;) {
      const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK - 1, total - 1);
      const g = await getRange(r.url, start, end);
      if (g.status === 403) out.http403 += 1;
      if (g.status !== 206 || !g.buf || g.buf.byteLength !== end - start + 1) {
        out.failByte = start;
        out.status = g.status === 403 ? 'A_FAIL_403' : 'A_FAIL_OTHER';
        break;
      }
      fs.writeSync(fd, g.buf);
      start += g.buf.byteLength;
      out.chunksOk += 1;
      out.cachedBytes = start;
      await sleep(BETWEEN_CHUNKS_MS);
    }
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
  if (out.status === null) {
    out.status = out.cachedBytes === total && fs.statSync(partFile).size === total ? 'A_PASS' : 'A_FAIL_SIZE';
  }
  out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return out;
}

// ---------- recovery ladder shared by B (also used for natural failures) ----------
async function ladder(name, video, byte, end, blacklist, stats, curUrl) {
  // stats: {refreshes, http403} mutated; returns {step, url, host, urlHash, subClient, ms} or {step:0 fail}
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const rec = { step: 0, url: curUrl || null, host: null, urlHash: null, subClient: null, ms: null, fail: null };
  const clean = () => getRange(rec.url, byte, end);
  // L1: same URL retry after 500ms (caller sets rec.url first)
  await sleep(500);
  let g = await clean();
  if (g.status === 403) stats.http403 += 1;
  if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - byte + 1) {
    rec.step = 1; rec.buf = g.buf; rec.ms = Date.now() - t0; return rec;
  }
  // L2..L5
  const attempts = [
    { step: 2, how: 'same-client same-VD', fn: async () => resolveClient(name, video, 'slot') },
    { step: 3, how: 'same-client fresh-VD', fn: async () => resolveClient(name, video, 'fresh') },
    { step: 4, how: 'next-client', fn: async () => {
      const sub = nextInChain(name, blacklist);
      if (!sub) return { ok: false, error: 'no substitute (all blacklisted)', _sub: null };
      const rr = await resolveClient(sub, video, 'slot');
      rr._sub = sub;
      return rr;
    } },
    { step: 5, how: 'next-client fresh-VD', fn: async () => {
      const sub = nextInChain(name, blacklist);
      if (!sub) return { ok: false, error: 'no substitute (all blacklisted)', _sub: null };
      const rr = await resolveClient(sub, video, 'fresh');
      rr._sub = sub;
      return rr;
    } },
  ];
  for (const a of attempts) {
    if (stats.refreshes >= MAX_REFRESH && a.step <= 3) {
      rec.fail = 'refresh budget exhausted';
      break;
    }
    const rr = await a.fn();
    stats.refreshes += 1;
    if (!rr.ok) {
      rec.lastResolveError = rr.error;
      continue;
    }
    if (rr.total && rr.total !== stats.total) {
      rec.totalMismatch = { was: stats.total, now: rr.total };
    }
    rec.url = rr.url; rec.host = rr.host; rec.urlHash = rr.urlHash;
    if (rr._sub) rec.subClient = rr._sub;
    g = await getRange(rec.url, byte, end);
    if (g.status === 403) stats.http403 += 1;
    if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - byte + 1) {
      rec.step = a.step; rec.buf = g.buf; rec.ms = Date.now() - t0; return rec;
    }
  }
  rec.fail = rec.fail || 'ladder exhausted';
  rec.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return rec;
}

// ---------- SCENARIO B: sabotage chunk 11, then ladder ----------
const SABOTAGE = ['auth-header', 'range-overflow', 'offset-shift'];
async function scenarioB(name, video, songDir, seed, blacklist) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const rng = mulberry32(seedOf(seed, video, name));
  const method = SABOTAGE[Math.floor(rng() * SABOTAGE.length)];
  const out = { mode: 'B', client: name, video, sabotage: method,
    resolve: null, chunksOk: 0, http403: 0, inducedStatus: null,
    recoveredStep: null, naturalRecoveries: [], subClient: null, refreshes: 0, ladderMs: null,
    cachedBytes: 0, total: null, status: null, ms: null, partFile: null, blacklisted: false };
  const stats = { refreshes: 0, http403: 0, total: null };
  const rr0 = await resolveClient(name, video, 'slot');
  if (!rr0.ok) {
    out.resolve = { ok: false, error: rr0.error };
    out.status = 'B_FAIL_RESOLVE';
    out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
    return out;
  }
  out.resolve = { ok: true, itag: rr0.itag, host: rr0.host, urlHash: rr0.urlHash,
    vdAttached: rr0.vdAttached, durSec: rr0.durSec };
  const total = rr0.total;
  if (!total) { out.status = 'B_FAIL_NO_TOTAL'; out.ms = Date.now() - t0; return out; }
  out.total = total; stats.total = total;
  const nChunks = Math.ceil(total / CHUNK);
  const sabIdx = nChunks > 13 ? SABOTAGE_IDX : Math.max(1, Math.floor(nChunks / 2));
  let url = rr0.url;
  const partFile = path.join(songDir, `B_${name}.part`);
  out.partFile = partFile;
  const fd = fs.openSync(partFile, 'w');
  let received = 0;
  try {
    for (let idx = 0; idx < nChunks; idx += 1) {
      const start = idx * CHUNK;
      const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK - 1, total - 1);
      if (idx === sabIdx) {
        // --- sabotage request (body always discarded) ---
        let g;
        if (method === 'auth-header') {
          g = await getRange(url, start, end, { Authorization: 'Bearer INVALID_TEST_TOKEN' });
        } else if (method === 'range-overflow') {
          g = await getRange(url, 99999999, 99999999 + CHUNK - 1);
        } else {
          g = await getRange(url, start + 1024, end + 1024);
        }
        out.inducedStatus = g.status;
        if (g.status === 403) { out.http403 += 1; stats.http403 += 1; }
        if (g.status === 206) {
          // sabotage ineffective at HTTP level: re-fetch CLEAN bytes and write them
          out.recoveredStep = 'N/A-no-error';
          const clean = await getRange(url, start, end);
          if (clean.status === 206 && clean.buf && clean.buf.byteLength === end - start + 1) {
            fs.writeSync(fd, clean.buf);
            received = end + 1;
            out.chunksOk += 1;
            out.cachedBytes = received;
          } else {
            const lr0 = await ladder(name, video, start, end, blacklist, stats, url);
            out.refreshes = stats.refreshes;
            out.http403 = stats.http403;
            out.ladderMs = lr0.ms;
            if (lr0.step > 0) {
              out.recoveredStep = lr0.step;
              if (lr0.subClient) out.subClient = lr0.subClient;
              if (lr0.host) { url = lr0.url; out.resolve.host = lr0.host; out.resolve.urlHash = lr0.urlHash; }
              fs.writeSync(fd, lr0.buf);
              received = end + 1;
              out.chunksOk += 1;
              out.cachedBytes = received;
            } else {
              out.status = 'B_FAIL_LADDER';
              out.failByte = start;
              break;
            }
          }
        } else {
          const lr = await ladder(name, video, start, end, blacklist, stats, url);
          out.refreshes = stats.refreshes;
          out.http403 = stats.http403;
          out.ladderMs = lr.ms;
          if (lr.step > 0) {
            out.recoveredStep = lr.step;
            if (lr.subClient) out.subClient = lr.subClient;
            if (lr.host) { url = lr.url; out.resolve.host = lr.host; out.resolve.urlHash = lr.urlHash; }
            fs.writeSync(fd, lr.buf);
            received = end + 1;
            out.chunksOk += 1;
            out.cachedBytes = received;
          } else {
            out.status = 'B_FAIL_LADDER';
            out.failByte = start;
            break;
          }
        }
        await sleep(BETWEEN_CHUNKS_MS);
        continue;
      }
      // --- normal chunk (natural failure -> ladder too) ---
      const g = await getRange(url, start, end);
      if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - start + 1) {
        fs.writeSync(fd, g.buf);
        received = end + 1;
        out.chunksOk += 1;
        out.cachedBytes = received;
        await sleep(BETWEEN_CHUNKS_MS);
        continue;
      }
      if (g.status === 403) { out.http403 += 1; stats.http403 += 1; }
      const lr = await ladder(name, video, start, end, blacklist, stats, url);
      out.refreshes = stats.refreshes;
      out.http403 = stats.http403;
      out.ladderMs = (out.ladderMs || 0) + lr.ms;
      if (lr.step > 0) {
        out.naturalRecoveries.push({ idx, step: lr.step, sub: lr.subClient || null });
        if (lr.subClient && !out.subClient) out.subClient = lr.subClient;
        if (lr.host) { url = lr.url; }
        fs.writeSync(fd, lr.buf);
        received = end + 1;
        out.chunksOk += 1;
        out.cachedBytes = received;
        await sleep(BETWEEN_CHUNKS_MS);
        continue;
      }
      out.status = 'B_FAIL_LADDER';
      out.failByte = start;
      break;
    }
  } finally {
    fs.closeSync(fd);
  }
  // substitution / fail rules
  const failBy403 = out.http403 >= 3;
  if (out.status === null) {
    if (out.cachedBytes === total && fs.statSync(partFile).size === total) {
      out.status = out.recoveredStep === 'N/A-no-error' ? 'B_PASS_NO_ERROR' : 'B_PASS';
    } else {
      out.status = 'B_FAIL_SIZE';
    }
  }
  if ((out.status || '').startsWith('B_FAIL') || failBy403 || stats.refreshes >= MAX_REFRESH) {
    if (failBy403 || stats.refreshes >= MAX_REFRESH || (out.status || '').startsWith('B_FAIL')) {
      blacklist.add(name);
      out.blacklisted = true;
    }
  }
  out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return out;
}

// ---------- SCENARIO C: invalid visitorData block simulation ----------
async function scenarioC(name, video) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const out = { mode: 'C', client: name, video, attempts: [], resolveOk: false,
    chunksOk: 0, status: null, ms: null };
  let consecFail = 0;
  let goodUrl = null;
  for (let a = 1; a <= 3; a += 1) {
    const r = await resolveClient(name, video, 'invalid');
    out.attempts.push({ n: a, ok: r.ok, error: r.error || null,
      playability: r.playability || null, vdAttached: !!r.vdAttached });
    if (r.ok && r.url) {
      consecFail = 0;
      goodUrl = r;
      break;
    }
    consecFail += 1;
    if (consecFail >= 2) break; // unhealthy threshold
    await sleep(1000);
  }
  if (!goodUrl) {
    out.resolveOk = false;
    out.status = 'C_UNHEALTHY';
    out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
    return out;
  }
  out.resolveOk = true;
  out.urlHost = goodUrl.host; out.itag = goodUrl.itag;
  // try first 3 chunks with the invalid-VD url (no recovery)
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
    const start = i * CHUNK;
    const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK - 1, goodUrl.total - 1);
    const g = await getRange(goodUrl.url, start, end);
    if (g.status === 206 && g.buf && g.buf.byteLength === end - start + 1) {
      out.chunksOk += 1;
    } else {
      out.chunkFail = { idx: i, status: g.status };
      break;
    }
    await sleep(BETWEEN_CHUNKS_MS);
  }
  out.status = out.chunksOk === 3 ? 'C_HEALTHY' : 'C_URL_DEAD';
  out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return out;
}

      const c = await scenarioC(name, video);

      await sleep(1500);
```

```javascript
    const audios = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])]
      .filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats', ms: Date.now() - t0 };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}`, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
    return { ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag,
      total: best.contentLength ? parseInt(best.contentLength, 10) : null,
      host: new URL(best.url).host, urlHash: hash8(best.url), ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}`, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, {
      headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA },
    });
    const buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
    return { status: r.status, bytes: buf.byteLength, ms: Date.now() - t0 };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', bytes: 0, ms: Date.now() - t0, err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

async function runBranch(tag, video, byte, end, vdOrNull, vdHash) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const out = { branch: tag, vdHash, resolveOk: false, dlStatus: null, recovered: false, ms: null };
  const r = await resolveWithVd(video, vdOrNull);
  out.resolveMs = r.ms;
  out.resolveError = r.error || null;
  out.newUrlHash = r.urlHash || null;
  out.newHost = r.host || null;
  if (!r.ok) { out.ms = Date.now() - t0; return out; }
  out.resolveOk = true;
  const g = await getRange(r.url, byte, end);
  out.dlStatus = g.status;
  out.dlMs = g.ms;
  out.recovered = g.status === 206 && g.bytes === end - byte + 1;
  out.ms = Date.now() - t0;
  return out;
}

(async () => {
  const o = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  fs.mkdirSync(o.out, { recursive: true });
  const jsonl = path.join(o.out, 'results.jsonl');
  const log = (obj) => fs.appendFileSync(jsonl, JSON.stringify(obj) + '\n');
  console.log(`HUNT SONGS: ${o.songs.join(',')} OUT: ${o.out} TS: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);

  let found = null;
  for (const video of o.songs) {
    if (!vdSlot) await fetchVd();
    const r = await resolveWithVd(video, vdSlot);
    if (!r.ok || !r.total) {
      console.log(`[HUNT ${video}] resolve FAIL: ${r.error}`);
      log({ mode: 'HUNT', video, status: 'RESOLVE_FAIL', error: r.error });
      continue;
    }
    const total = r.total;
    let chunksOk = 0;
    let hit = null;
    for (let start = 0; start < total; start += CHUNK) {
      const end = Math.min(start + CHUNK - 1, total - 1);
      const g = await getRange(r.url, start, end);
      if (g.status === 206 && g.bytes === end - start + 1) {
        chunksOk += 1;
        await sleep(150);
        continue;
      }
      if (g.status === 403) {
        hit = { video, byte: start, end, chunk: start / CHUNK, url: r.url,
          host: r.host, itag: r.itag, total };
        break;
      }
      console.log(`[HUNT ${video}] non-403 status=${g.status} at ${start}, aborting song`);
      break;
    }
    if (hit) {
      console.log(`[HUNT ${video}] NATURAL 403 at byte ${hit.byte} (chunk ${hit.chunk}) after ${chunksOk} clean chunks`);
      log({ mode: 'HUNT', video, status: 'FOUND_403', ...hit, url: undefined });
      found = hit;
      break;
    }
    console.log(`[HUNT ${video}] clean (${chunksOk} chunks, no 403)`);
    log({ mode: 'HUNT', video, status: 'CLEAN', chunksOk, total });
    await sleep(2000);
  }

  if (!found) {
    console.log('NO_403: no natural VISIONOS 403 across all hunt songs');
    log({ mode: 'NO_403' });
    return;
  }

  // snapshot VD for branch A BEFORE parallel start (B rotates the slot)
  const vdSame = vdSlot;
  const vdSameHash = hash8(vdSame);
  console.log(`HEAD-TO-HEAD byte=${found.byte} end=${found.end} vdSameHash=${vdSameHash}`);
  const [A, B] = await Promise.all([
    runBranch('A', found.video, found.byte, found.end, vdSame, vdSameHash),
    (async () => {
      const vdNew = await fetchVd(); // rotates slot; A already holds its snapshot
      return runBranch('B', found.video, found.byte, found.end, vdNew, hash8(vdNew));
    })(),
  ]);
  const vdDiffer = A.vdHash !== B.vdHash;
  let verdict;
  if (A.recovered && B.recovered) verdict = 'VD_BUKAN_KUNCI';
  else if (!A.recovered && B.recovered) verdict = 'VD_KUNCI';
  else verdict = 'IP_MASALAH';
  const rec = { mode: 'HEADTOHEAD', video: found.video, byte: found.byte, chunk: found.chunk,
    host: found.host, itag: found.itag, vdSameHash: A.vdHash, vdNewHash: B.vdHash,
    vdDiffer, A, B, verdict };
  log(rec);
  for (const b of [A, B]) {
    console.log(`[BRANCH ${b.branch}] vdHash=${b.vdHash} resolve=${b.resolveOk ? `OK ${b.resolveMs}ms` : 'FAIL:' + b.resolveError} ` +
      `dl=${b.dlStatus} recovered=${b.recovered} totalMs=${b.ms}`);
  }
  console.log(`VERDICT: ${verdict} (vdDiffer=${vdDiffer})`);
  console.log(`DONE. raw: ${jsonl}`);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* VD effective-lifetime measurement.
   Fetch up to N visitorDatas staggered (1/min); probe each every 60s with
   resolve + 3-chunk download on a fixed probe song until first failure
   (resolve !ok OR any chunk != 206) or CAP age (censored).
   Resumable across invocations via vd-state.json; each run works ~budget min.
   Usage: node scripts/client-vd-lifetime.js [--out=DIR] [--vds=N] [--cap-min=M]
     [--probe-sec=S] [--budget-min=B] [--summary] [--song=ID] */
'use strict';

const fs = require('fs');
const os = require('os');
const path = require('path');

const DEFAULT_OUT = 'C:\\Users\\Danial\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\client-vd-lifetime';
const CHUNK = 102400;
const CHUNK_UA = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36';
const REQ_TIMEOUT_MS = 25000;

const DEF = {
  endpoint: 'https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
  gapis: 'https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/',
  context: { client: {
    clientName: 'VISIONOS', clientVersion: '1.02', deviceModel: 'RealityDevice14,1',
    osName: 'visionOS', osVersion: '25.6.0.23O471', hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
  } },
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'User-Agent': 'com.google.visionos.youtube/1.02(RealityDevice14,1; U; CPU visionOS 25_6_0 like Mac OS X; US)',
    'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
  },
};

function parseArgs(argv) {
  const o = { out: DEFAULT_OUT, vds: 10, capMin: 15, probeSec: 60, budgetMin: 8.5,
    summary: false, song: 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' };
  for (const a of argv) {
    if (a.startsWith('--out=')) o.out = a.slice(6);
    else if (a.startsWith('--vds=')) o.vds = Math.max(1, parseInt(a.slice(6), 10) || 10);
    else if (a.startsWith('--cap-min=')) o.capMin = Math.max(1, parseFloat(a.slice(10)) || 15);
    else if (a.startsWith('--probe-sec=')) o.probeSec = Math.max(10, parseInt(a.slice(12), 10) || 60);
    else if (a.startsWith('--budget-min=')) o.budgetMin = Math.max(1, parseFloat(a.slice(13)) || 8.5);
    else if (a === '--summary') o.summary = true;
    else if (a.startsWith('--song=')) o.song = a.slice(7).trim() || o.song;
  }
  return o;
}

const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function fetchTimeout(url, opts = {}, ms = REQ_TIMEOUT_MS) {
  const ctl = new AbortController();
  const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), ms);
  try {
    return await fetch(url, { ...opts, signal: ctl.signal });
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(t);
  }
}

async function fetchVdOnce() {
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEF.context));
  const res = await fetchTimeout(`${DEF.gapis}visitor_id?prettyPrint=false`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: DEF.headers, body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`visitor_id HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const vd = (await res.json())?.responseContext?.visitorData;
  if (!vd) throw new Error('visitor_id: no visitorData');
  return vd;
}

async function resolveWithVd(video, vd) {
  const ctx = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DEF.context));
  if (vd) ctx.client.visitorData = vd;
  try {
    const res = await fetchTimeout(DEF.endpoint, {
      method: 'POST', headers: DEF.headers,
      body: JSON.stringify({ context: ctx, videoId: video, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: `player HTTP ${res.status}` };
    const data = await res.json();
    const sd = data.streamingData;
    if (!sd) {
      const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
      return { ok: false, error: `no streamingData playability=${ps.status} reason=${ps.reason || '-'}` };
    }
    const audios = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])]
      .filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
    if (!audios.length) return { ok: false, error: 'no audio formats' };
    audios.sort((a, b) => {
      const ao = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      const bo = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
      if (ao !== bo) return bo - ao;
      return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
    });
    const best = audios[0];
    if (!best.url) return { ok: false, error: `cipher-only itag ${best.itag}` };
    return { ok: true, url: best.url, itag: best.itag, host: new URL(best.url).host };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: `exception: ${e.message}` };
  }
}

async function getRange(url, start, end) {
  try {
    const r = await fetchTimeout(url, {
      headers: { Range: `bytes=${start}-${end}`, 'User-Agent': CHUNK_UA },
    });
    await r.arrayBuffer();
    return { status: r.status };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', err: String(e.message || e) };
  }
}

function loadState(out) {
  const p = path.join(out, 'vd-state.json');
  try {
    return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
  } catch {
    return { vds: [], lastFetchTs: 0, song: null };
  }
}
function saveState(out, st) {
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'vd-state.json'), JSON.stringify(st, null, 1));
}

(async () => {
  const o = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  fs.mkdirSync(o.out, { recursive: true });
  const jsonl = path.join(o.out, 'results.jsonl');
  const log = (obj) => fs.appendFileSync(jsonl, JSON.stringify(obj) + '\n');
  const st = loadState(o.out);
  if (!st.song) st.song = o.song;

  if (o.summary) {
    console.log('VD | fetchTs | failTs | ageMin | result | note');
    for (const v of st.vds) {
      const age = v.failTs ? ((v.failTs - v.fetchTs) / 60000).toFixed(1)
        : (((Date.now() - v.fetchTs) / 60000).toFixed(1) + '+');
      console.log(`#${v.n} | ${new Date(v.fetchTs).toISOString().slice(11, 19)} | ` +
        `${v.failTs ? new Date(v.failTs).toISOString().slice(11, 19) : '-'} | ${age} | ` +
        `${v.fetchFail ? 'FETCH_FAIL' : v.failKind ? 'FAIL(' + v.failKind + ')' : v.censored ? 'CENSORED' : 'ACTIVE'} | ${v.note || ''}`);
    }
    return;
  }

  console.log(`VD-LIFETIME song=${st.song} target=${o.vds} cap=${o.capMin}min probe=${o.probeSec}s budget=${o.budgetMin}min OUT: ${o.out}`);
  const runStart = Date.now();
  const deadline = runStart + o.budgetMin * 60000;
  const grid0 = runStart;
  let tick = 0;
  for (;;) {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now >= deadline) break;
    // (a) fetch next VD if due (staggered 1/min)
    const pending = st.vds.length;
    if (pending < o.vds && (pending === 0 || now - st.lastFetchTs >= 60000)) {
      const n = pending + 1;
      try {
        const vd = await fetchVdOnce();
        st.vds.push({ n, vd, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: false });
        st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
        console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] ok`);
        log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, fetchTs: st.lastFetchTs });
      } catch (e) {
        await sleep(5000);
        try {
          const vd = await fetchVdOnce();
          st.vds.push({ n, vd, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: false });
          st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
          console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] ok (retry)`);
          log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, fetchTs: st.lastFetchTs, retried: true });
        } catch (e2) {
          st.vds.push({ n, vd: null, fetchTs: Date.now(), done: true, fetchFail: true, note: String((e2 && e2.message) || e2) });
          st.lastFetchTs = Date.now();
          console.log(`[FETCH VD#${n}] FAIL ${e2.message}`);
          log({ mode: 'VD_FETCH', n, ok: false, error: String((e2 && e2.message) || e2) });
        }
      }
      saveState(o.out, st);
    }
    // (b) probe all active VDs
    for (const v of st.vds) {
      if (v.done || !v.vd) continue;
      const ageMin = (Date.now() - v.fetchTs) / 60000;
      if (ageMin >= o.capMin) {
        v.done = true; v.censored = true;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] CENSORED age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min`);
        log({ mode: 'VD_CENSORED', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1) });
        continue;
      }
      const r = await resolveWithVd(st.song, v.vd);
      if (!r.ok) {
        v.done = true; v.failTs = Date.now(); v.failKind = 'resolve';
        v.note = r.error;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] FAIL-resolve age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min ${r.error}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: false, kind: 'resolve', detail: r.error });
        continue;
      }
      let bad = null;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i += 1) {
        const g = await getRange(r.url, i * CHUNK, Math.min(i * CHUNK + CHUNK - 1, 3 * CHUNK - 1));
        if (g.status !== 206) { bad = { chunk: i, status: g.status }; break; }
      }
      if (bad) {
        v.done = true; v.failTs = Date.now(); v.failKind = 'dl';
        v.note = `chunk${bad.chunk}=${bad.status}`;
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] FAIL-dl age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min ${v.note}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: false, kind: 'dl', detail: v.note });
      } else {
        console.log(`[VD#${v.n}] ok age=${ageMin.toFixed(1)}min host=${r.host}`);
        log({ mode: 'PROBE', n: v.n, ageMin: +ageMin.toFixed(1), ok: true, host: r.host });
      }
    }
    saveState(o.out, st);
    const allDone = st.vds.length >= o.vds && st.vds.every((v) => v.done);
    if (allDone) { console.log('ALL DONE'); break; }
    tick += 1;
    const nextGrid = grid0 + tick * o.probeSec * 1000;
    const wait = nextGrid - Date.now();
    if (wait > 0) await sleep(wait);
  }
  saveState(o.out, st);
  console.log(`RUN END. state: ${path.join(o.out, 'vd-state.json')} raw: ${jsonl}`);
})().catch((e) => { console.error('FATAL', e); process.exit(1); });
```

```powershell
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing
```

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const output = path.join(root, 'PROJECT_DUMP.md');

const explicit = [
  'README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'package.json', 'capacitor.config.json',
  'vercel.json', '.eslintrc.json', 'server.js', 'api/index.js',
  'public/app.js', 'public/index.html', 'public/styles.css', 'public/sw.js',
  'public/manifest.json', 'public/diag.html', 'public/diag-hook.js',
  'android/build.gradle', 'android/settings.gradle', 'android/variables.gradle',
  'android/capacitor.settings.gradle', 'android/app/build.gradle',
  'android/app/capacitor.build.gradle', 'android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml',
  'docs/architecture.md', 'docs/background-playback-analysis.md',
  'docs/offline-scope.md', 'docs/offline-test-plan.md', 'scripts/FASE0-AUDIT.md',
  'tests/parse.test.js', 'test/background-test-plan.md',
];

function walk(dir) {
  const out = [];
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (['node_modules', '.git', 'build', 'release', 'cache'].includes(entry.name)) continue;
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) out.push(...walk(full));
    else if (/\.(java|kt|xml|gradle|js|json|md|html|css|sh|ps1)$/.test(entry.name)) out.push(full);
  }
  return out;
}

const files = new Set(explicit.map((p) => path.join(root, p)));
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'android', 'app', 'src', 'main'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'scripts'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'public'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'api'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'docs'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'tests'))) files.add(file);
for (const file of walk(path.join(root, 'test'))) files.add(file);

const extLang = {
  '.java': 'java', '.kt': 'kotlin', '.js': 'javascript', '.json': 'json',
  '.gradle': 'gradle', '.xml': 'xml', '.html': 'html', '.css': 'css',
  '.md': 'markdown', '.sh': 'bash', '.ps1': 'powershell',
};
const sorted = [...files].filter((f) => fs.existsSync(f)).sort();
const lines = [
  '# Dnialify Music Stream: Full Ecosystem Dump',
  '',
  '> Generated from repository source. Generated artifacts, dependencies, binaries, secrets, and local cache files omitted.',
  '',
  '## Project Map',
  '',
  '- `public/`: SPA frontend, service worker, styles, static assets.',
  '- `server.js`: Express API proxy, metadata, lyrics, stream URL resolution, persistent audio cache.',
  '- `android/`: Capacitor Android shell and native playback/cache implementation.',
  '- `scripts/`: diagnostics, integration tests, release/version tooling.',
  '- `docs/`: architecture, background playback, offline/cache design.',
  '',
  '## Source Files',
  '',
];

for (const file of sorted) {
  const rel = path.relative(root, file).replaceAll(path.sep, '/');
  const content = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8').replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
  const ext = path.extname(file).toLowerCase();
  const lang = extLang[ext] || '';
  const count = content.split('\n').length;
  lines.push(`### Path: ${rel}`);
  if (count > 800) lines.push('> `// [FILE BESAR - FULL]` Full file included below.');
  lines.push('', `\`\`\`${lang}`, content.replace(/\n$/, ''), '\`\`\`', '');
}

fs.writeFileSync(output, lines.join('\n'));
console.log(`Wrote ${output} (${sorted.length} files)`);
```

```javascript
const channel = isBeta ? 'beta' : 'stable';

// public/app.js
const appPath = path.join(root, 'public', 'app.js');
let appSrc = fs.readFileSync(appPath, 'utf8');
appSrc = appSrc.replace(/const APP_VERSION = "[^"]+";/, `const APP_VERSION = "${ver}";`);
if (!appSrc.includes('const APP_VERSION')) throw new Error('APP_VERSION not found in app.js');
fs.writeFileSync(appPath, appSrc);

// public/index.html - meta + VER var (header no longer carries version)
const htmlPath = path.join(root, 'public', 'index.html');
let html = fs.readFileSync(htmlPath, 'utf8');
html = html.replace(/<meta name="app-version" content="[^"]+" \/>/, `<meta name="app-version" content="${ver}" />`);
html = html.replace(/var VER="[^"]+";/, `var VER="${ver}";`);
fs.writeFileSync(htmlPath, html);

// public/sw.js
const swPath = path.join(root, 'public', 'sw.js');
let sw = fs.readFileSync(swPath, 'utf8');
sw = sw.replace(/const CACHE='[^']+';/, `const CACHE='dnialify-assets-v${ver}';`);
fs.writeFileSync(swPath, sw);

// public/manifest.json version field
const manifestPath = path.join(root, 'public', 'manifest.json');
if (fs.existsSync(manifestPath)) {
  const m = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, 'utf8'));
  m.version = ver;
  fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, JSON.stringify(m, null, 2) + '\n');
}

// also sync android versionName via build.gradle reading package.json (no hardcode needed), but log
console.log(`Injected version ${ver} channel=${channel} -> app.js, index.html, sw.js, manifest.json (android versionName reads package.json)`);
```

```powershell
param([string]$Branch="feature/apk-chromium-shell", [int]$TimeoutMin=60, [int]$IntervalSec=30)
$start = Get-Date
Write-Host "Monitor CI branch $Branch timeout ${TimeoutMin}m interval ${IntervalSec}s" -ForegroundColor Cyan
while (((Get-Date)-$start).TotalMinutes -lt $TimeoutMin) {
  try {
    $json = rtk gh run list --branch $Branch --limit 1 --json databaseId,status,conclusion,headSha,createdAt 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw $json }
    $run = $json | ConvertFrom-Json
    if ($run -is [Array]) { $run = $run[0] }
    if (-not $run) { Write-Host "no run yet, retry $IntervalSec sec..." ; Start-Sleep $IntervalSec; continue }
    $id = $run.databaseId; $st=$run.status; $con=$run.conclusion; $sha=$run.headSha.Substring(0,7)
    Write-Host "$(Get-Date -Format HH:mm:ss) run $id $sha $st/$con"
    if ($st -eq "completed") {
      rtk gh run view $id --log 2>&1 | Out-File -Append "ci-monitor.log"
      if ($con -eq "success") { Write-Host "SUCCESS $id" -ForegroundColor Green; exit 0 }
      else { Write-Host "FAILED $con" -ForegroundColor Red; rtk gh run view $id --log 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 80; exit 1 }
    }
  } catch {
    Write-Host "gh error: $_" -ForegroundColor Yellow
  }
  Start-Sleep $IntervalSec
}
Write-Host "TIMEOUT ${TimeoutMin}m" -ForegroundColor Yellow; exit 2
```

```javascript
// Parser log uji 2D (shared ExoPlayer MediaSession) -> report.md tabel T1-T6.
// Pakai: node scripts/parse-2d-notification.js <output-dir>
// Nol dependensi. Idempotent: tulis ulang report.md tiap jalan.

};

  results.push({ id, name, pass, evidence: String(evidence).slice(0, 300) });

const notifFinal = read("notif-final.txt");
const full = read("t2d.log");

{

    && /backend=exo/.test(full);
  let cause = "PLAYING exo tercapai";
  if (!reached) {
    cause = "tidak mencapai PLAYING";
    if (/\[FOCUS\] change=-1|event: handleLoss/.test(full)) {
      cause += "; FOCUS LOSS saat start (perebutan fokus, cek audio-focus.txt)";
    } else if (!/backend=exo/.test(full)) {
      cause += "; backend exo tidak aktif";
    } else if (/TIMEOUT|PREFIX_TIMEOUT|resolve failed/i.test(full)) {
      cause += "; resolve/prefix gagal";
    }
  }
  verdict("T0", "Precondition PLAYING backend=exo", reached, cause);
}
const t2pause = read("log-t2-pause.txt");
const t2play = read("log-t2-play.txt");
const t3 = read("log-t3.txt");
const t4 = read("log-t4.txt");

// ---------- T1 ----------
{
  const has1002 = /id=1002/.test(notifPlaying)
    && /com\.dnialify\.musicstream/.test(notifPlaying);
  const block = (notifPlaying.match(
    /NotificationRecord\([^\n]*com\.dnialify\.musicstream[^\n]*id=1002[^\n]*\n(?:.*\n){0,60}/) || [""])[0];
  const hasActions = /actions=|action\d*=/i.test(block) || /PLAY|PAUSE/i.test(block);
  verdict("T1", "Notifikasi 1002 muncul saat PLAYING",
    has1002, has1002 ? `id=1002 pkg ok, actions=${hasActions}` : "id=1002 tidak ketemu");
}

// ---------- T2 ----------
function stateAfter(log, marker, want) {
  const i = log.indexOf(marker);
  if (i < 0) return { ok: false, why: "marker " + marker + " hilang" };
  const tail = log.slice(i);
  const m = tail.match(/(?:state["'=:\s]+|->\s*)(PLAYING|PAUSED|BUFFERING|ENDED)/);
  if (!m) return { ok: false, why: "tidak ada state setelah marker" };
  return { ok: m[1] === want, why: "state=" + m[1] + " (mau " + want + ")" };
}
{
  const p = stateAfter(t2pause, "[TEST2D] action=pause", "PAUSED");
  const r = stateAfter(t2play, "[TEST2D] action=play", "PLAYING");
  const hasActions = /\[TEST2D\] action=pause/.test(full)
    && /\[TEST2D\] action=play/.test(full);
  verdict("T2", "Pause/resume via broadcast",
    p.ok && r.ok && hasActions, `pause: ${p.why}; resume: ${r.why}`);
}

// ---------- T3 ----------
{
  const plays = [...t3.matchAll(/\[AUTONEXT-TEST\] play#(\d+) videoId=(\S+)/g)]
    .map((m) => ({ n: Number(m[1]), vid: m[2] }));
  const ni = t3.indexOf("[TEST2D] action=next");
  const after = ni >= 0 ? plays.filter((p) => t3.indexOf(
    `[AUTONEXT-TEST] play#${p.n} videoId=${p.vid}`) > ni) : [];
  const vids = [...new Set(after.map((p) => p.vid))];
  const seekOk = /\[TEST2D\] action=seek seconds=30/.test(t3);
  verdict("T3", "Next/seek ganti lagu",
    ni >= 0 && vids.length >= 1 && seekOk,
    ni < 0 ? "action=next hilang" : `lanjut ke: ${vids.join(",")} seek30=${seekOk}`);
}

// ---------- T4 ----------
{
  const dp = read("dispatch-pause.txt") + read("dispatch-play.txt");
  const cmdOk = !/not found|Unknown command|Bad/.test(dp);
  const p = stateAfter(t4, "T4 dispatch pause sent", "PAUSED");
  const r = stateAfter(t4, "T4 dispatch play sent", "PLAYING");
  const pass = cmdOk ? (p.ok && r.ok) : false;
  verdict("T4", "media dispatch pause/play",
    pass, `cmd=${cmdOk ? "ok" : "gagal"} pause: ${p.why}; play: ${r.why}`);
}

// ---------- T5 ----------
function ongoing(txt) {
  const i = txt.indexOf("id=1002");
  if (i < 0 || !txt.includes("com.dnialify.musicstream")) return null;
  const seg = txt.slice(i, i + 4000);
  const m = seg.match(/flags=([A-Z_|]+)/);

{

// ---------- T6 ----------
function countId(txt, id, legacy) {
  const rec = (want) => (txt.match(new RegExp(

}
{

    c.n >= 1 && c.old === 0, `id1002=${c.n} id1001=${c.old}`);
}

const passN = results.filter((r) => r.pass).length;
const md = [

  "",

  "",
  "| Test | Nama | Hasil | Bukti |",
  "|---|---|---|---|",
  ...results.map((r) => `| ${r.id} | ${r.name} | ${r.pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} | ${r.evidence} |`),
  "",
  `Log: t2d.log (${full.split("\n").length} baris)`,
  "",
].join("\n");
fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "report.md"), md);
console.log(`Report: ${path.join(outDir, "report.md")}`);
for (const r of results) console.log(`- ${r.id}: ${r.pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} ${r.evidence}`);
if (passN < results.length) process.exit(2);
```

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Parser log uji ExoPlayer vs MediaPlayer -> report.md tabel perbandingan.
// Pakai: node scripts/parse-exo-vs-media.js <output-dir>
// Nol dependensi. Idempotent: tulis ulang report.md tiap jalan.
const fs = require("fs");
const path = require("path");

const outDir = process.argv[2];
if (!outDir || !fs.existsSync(outDir)) {
  console.error("Usage: node scripts/parse-exo-vs-media.js <output-dir>");
  process.exit(1);
}

// logcat -d default: "MM-DD HH:MM:SS.mmm  pid  tid level tag: msg"
function parseTs(line) {
  const m = line.match(/^(\d\d)-(\d\d) (\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)\.(\d\d\d)/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const now = new Date();
  return new Date(
    now.getFullYear(), Number(m[1]) - 1, Number(m[2]),
    Number(m[3]), Number(m[4]), Number(m[5]), Number(m[6])).getTime();
}

function analyzeFile(file) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
  const lines = text.split("\n");
  const base = path.basename(file, ".log");
  const dash = base.indexOf("-");
  const mode = dash > 0 ? base.slice(0, dash) : "?";
  const videoId = dash > 0 ? base.slice(dash + 1) : base;

  const r = {
    file: path.basename(file), mode, videoId,
    readyAt: false, rebuffers: 0, bufferSec: 0,
    stalls: 0, tickGaps: 0, maxTickGapMs: 0,
    endPos: -1, endVerdict: "", duration: -1,
    premature: false, setupFail: false, errors: [],
    lastTickTs: -1, lastTickPos: -1, bufferingSince: -1,
  };

  for (const line of lines) {
    if (!line.includes("[EXO]") && !line.includes("[ENGINE]")
        && !line.includes("[AUTONEXT_DIAG]") && !line.includes("[LSS]")) continue;
    const ts = parseTs(line);
    let m;
    if ((m = line.match(/\[EXO\] state=(\w+) pos=(-?\d+) buf=(-?\d+) videoId=(\S+)/))) {
      const [, st, pos] = m;
      if (st === "READY" && !r.readyAt) r.readyAt = true;
      if (st === "BUFFERING" && r.readyAt) {
        r.rebuffers++;
        if (ts != null) r.bufferingSince = ts;
      }
      if (st === "READY" && r.bufferingSince > 0 && ts != null) {
        r.bufferSec += (ts - r.bufferingSince) / 1000;
        r.bufferingSince = -1;
      }
      if (st === "ENDED" && r.endPos < 0) r.endPos = Number(pos);
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[EXO\] tick videoId=(\S+) pos=(-?\d+) dur=(-?\d+) buf=(-?\d+)/))) {
      const pos = Number(m[2]), dur = Number(m[3]);
      if (dur > 0) r.duration = Math.max(r.duration, dur);
      if (ts != null && r.lastTickTs > 0 && r.readyAt) {
        const gap = ts - r.lastTickTs;
        if (gap > r.maxTickGapMs) r.maxTickGapMs = gap;
        // Tick normal 500ms; gap >3.5s + posisi beku = stall.
        if (gap > 3500 && pos === r.lastTickPos) r.tickGaps++;
      }
      if (ts != null) { r.lastTickTs = ts; r.lastTickPos = pos; }
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[EXO\] ENDED videoId=(\S+) pos=(-?\d+) consumed=(-?\d+) available=(-?\d+) verdict=(\w+)/))) {
      r.endPos = Number(m[2]);
      r.endVerdict = m[5];
      if (m[5] !== "genuine") r.premature = true;
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[EXO\] ERROR videoId=(\S+) reason=(\S+) pos=(-?\d+)/))) {
      r.errors.push(`${m[2]}@${m[3]}`);
      if (m[2] === "STALL_3S") r.stalls++;
      if (m[2] === "PREMATURE_END") r.premature = true;
    } else if (/\[EXO\] stall pos=/.test(line)) {
      r.stalls++;
    } else if (/resolve failed|PREFIX_TIMEOUT|growing-file prefix timeout/.test(line)) {
      r.setupFail = true;
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[EXO\] window set chunk=(\d+) end=(\d+) curMs=(\d+) slides=(\d+)/))) {
      // FASE B (spike production-like): hitung slides + end terakhir.
      r.winSlides = Number(m[4]);
      r.winEnd = Number(m[2]);
    } else if (/\[EXO\] pause reason=cap-hit/.test(line)) {
      r.winCapHits = (r.winCapHits || 0) + 1;
    } else if (/\[EXO\] byte needed pos=/.test(line)) {
      r.winByteWaits = (r.winByteWaits || 0) + 1;
    } else if (/\[EXO\] download complete videoId=/.test(line)) {
      r.winComplete = true;
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[ENGINE\] Genuine onCompletion: pos=(-?\d+) dur=(-?\d+)/))) {
      // Baseline MediaPlayer (untuk run mode=media di masa depan).
      if (r.endPos < 0) { r.endPos = Number(m[1]); r.endVerdict = "genuine(media)"; }
    } else if ((m = line.match(/\[ENGINE\] Premature onCompletion: pos=(-?\d+) dur=(-?\d+)/))) {
      r.premature = true;
    } else if ((m = line.match(/onCompletion fired\. currentPosition=(-?\d+) duration=(-?\d+)/))) {
      if (r.duration < 0 && Number(m[2]) > 0) r.duration = Number(m[2]);
    }
  }
  if (r.bufferingSince > 0 && r.lastTickTs > r.bufferingSince) {
    r.bufferSec += (r.lastTickTs - r.bufferingSince) / 1000;
  }
  r.stutter = r.stalls + r.tickGaps;
  // Skip prematur: verdict premature, atau end <90% durasi yang diketahui.
  r.skipPrematur = r.premature
    || (r.endPos >= 0 && r.duration > 0 && r.endPos < r.duration * 0.9);
  if (r.setupFail) r.verdict = "SETUP_FAIL";
  else if (r.endPos < 0 && !r.premature) r.verdict = "NO_END";
  else if (r.skipPrematur || r.stutter >= 2) r.verdict = "FAIL";
  else r.verdict = "PASS";
  return r;
}

const files = fs.readdirSync(outDir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".log")).sort();
if (files.length === 0) {
  console.error(`Tidak ada *.log di ${outDir}`);
  process.exit(1);
}

// FASE 2: ringkas baris [AUTONEXT-TEST] (harness mode=native) apa adanya.
const autonextLines = [];
for (const f of files) {
  const text = fs.readFileSync(path.join(outDir, f), "utf8");
  for (const line of text.split("\n")) {
    if (line.includes("[AUTONEXT-TEST]")) {
      const m = line.match(/(\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d:\d\d\.\d+).*(\[AUTONEXT-TEST\].*)/);
      autonextLines.push((m ? m[1] + " " : "") + (m ? m[2] : line.trim()));
    }
  }
}

const rows = files.map((f) => analyzeFile(path.join(outDir, f)));
let md = `# Exo vs Media — Report Otomatis\n\n`;
md += `Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}\n\n`;
md += `| VideoId | Mode | End Pos | Durasi | Stutter | Rebuffer | Buffer(s) | Skip Prematur? | Verdict |\n`;
md += `|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n`;
for (const r of rows) {
  md += `| ${r.videoId} | ${r.mode} | ${r.endPos} | ${r.duration} | ${r.stutter} `
    + `(stall=${r.stalls},gap=${r.tickGaps},maxGap=${r.maxTickGapMs}ms) | ${r.rebuffers} `
    + `| ${r.bufferSec.toFixed(1)} | ${r.skipPrematur ? "YA" : "tidak"}${r.endVerdict ? ` (${r.endVerdict})` : ""} | ${r.verdict} |\n`;
}
md += `\n## Detail per lagu\n\n`;
for (const r of rows) {
  md += `### ${r.mode}-${r.videoId} → ${r.verdict}\n\n`;
  md += `- endPos=${r.endPos} duration=${r.duration} endVerdict=${r.endVerdict || "-"}\n`;
  md += `- stutter=${r.stutter} (STALL_3S=${r.stalls}, tickGap>3.5s=${r.tickGaps}, maxGap=${r.maxTickGapMs}ms)\n`;
  md += `- rebuffers=${r.rebuffers} bufferSec=${r.bufferSec.toFixed(1)}\n`;
  md += `- errors: ${r.errors.length ? r.errors.join(", ") : "-"}\n`;
  md += `- setupFail=${r.setupFail}\n`;
  if (r.winSlides || r.winCapHits || r.winByteWaits || r.winComplete) {
    md += `- window: slides=${r.winSlides || 0} capHits=${r.winCapHits || 0} `
      + `byteWaits=${r.winByteWaits || 0} complete=${r.winComplete ? "ya" : "tidak"}\n`;
  }
  md += `\n`;
}
const winRows = rows.filter((r) => r.winSlides || r.winCapHits || r.winByteWaits || r.winComplete);
if (winRows.length) {
  md += `## Window (spike production-like)\n\n`;
  md += `| VideoId | Slides | Cap-hits | Byte-waits | Download complete? |\n`;
  md += `|---|---|---|---|\n`;
  for (const r of winRows) {
    md += `| ${r.videoId} | ${r.winSlides || 0} | ${r.winCapHits || 0} `
      + `| ${r.winByteWaits || 0} | ${r.winComplete ? "ya" : "tidak"} |\n`;
  }
  md += `\n`;
}
md += `## Cara baca\n\n`;
md += `- Stutter: gap tick >3.5s saat posisi beku + event STALL_3S. Bandingkan antar mode.\n`;
md += `- End Pos vs Durasi: end <90% durasi = skip prematur.\n`;
md += `- PASS: stutter <2 dan end genuine/penuh. NO_END: lagu tak selesai dalam timeout. SETUP_FAIL: resolve/prefix gagal (jaringan/perizinan, bukan salah engine).\n`;
if (autonextLines.length) {
  md += `\n## Auto-next FASE 2 (mode=native)\n\n`;
  const done = autonextLines.filter((l) => l.includes("AUTONEXT-TEST] DONE"));
  md += `Plays tercatat: ${autonextLines.filter((l) => /play#\d+.*(ENDED|ERROR|TIMEOUT|EXCEPTION)/.test(l)).length}`
    + (done.length ? ` — ${done[done.length - 1]}` : " — DONE belum muncul (timeout/fatal, cek log)") + `\n\n`;
  md += "```\n" + autonextLines.join("\n") + "\n```\n";
}

fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, "report.md"), md);
console.log(`Report: ${path.join(outDir, "report.md")}`);
for (const r of rows) {
  console.log(`- ${r.mode}-${r.videoId}: ${r.verdict} end=${r.endPos}/${r.duration} stutter=${r.stutter}`);
}
for (const l of autonextLines.filter((l) => l.includes("AUTONEXT-TEST] DONE"))) {
  console.log(`- autonext: ${l}`);
}
```

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/* Isolated experiment: resolve YouTube googlevideo URL via selectable player client,
   then raw HTTP Range probe on the SAME URL (chunk1-4) to test >512KB accessibility.
   Usage:
     YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT=current  node scripts/probe-player-client.js [videoId]
     YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT=visionos node scripts/probe-player-client.js [videoId]
     YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT=android  node scripts/probe-player-client.js [videoId]
     YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT=mweb     node scripts/probe-player-client.js [videoId]
   Does NOT touch server.js / public/app.js. Read-only resolver + probe. */
'use strict';

const VIDEO_ID = process.argv[2] || 'M7lc1UVf-VE';
const CLIENT = (process.env.YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT || 'current').toLowerCase();

const CHUNKS = [
  { label: 'chunk1', range: 'bytes=0-524287' },
  { label: 'chunk2', range: 'bytes=524288-1048575' },
  { label: 'chunk3', range: 'bytes=1048576-1572863' },
  { label: 'chunk4', range: 'bytes=1572864-2097151' },
];

// ---- player client definitions (mirror server.js ANDROID_CONTEXT + PipePipe visionos) ----
const CLIENTS = {
  current: {
    endpoint: 'https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
    context: {
      client: {
        clientName: 'ANDROID', clientVersion: '20.10.38', androidSdkVersion: 35, hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
      },
    },
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'com.google.android.youtube/20.10.38 (Linux; U; Android 14; en_US)',
      'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
    },
  },
  android: {
    endpoint: 'https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
    context: {
      client: {
        clientName: 'ANDROID', clientVersion: '21.03.38', androidSdkVersion: 35, hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
      },
    },
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'com.google.android.youtube/21.03.38 (Linux; U; Android 14; en_US)',
      'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
    },
  },
  visionos: {
    endpoint: 'https://youtubei.googleapis.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
    context: {
      client: {
        clientName: 'VISIONOS', clientVersion: '1.02', deviceModel: 'RealityDevice14,1',
        osName: 'visionOS', osVersion: '25.6.0.23O471', hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
      },
    },
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'com.google.visionos.youtube/1.02(RealityDevice14,1; U; CPU visionOS 25_6_0 like Mac OS X; US)',
      'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
    },
  },
  mweb: {
    endpoint: 'https://www.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/player?prettyPrint=false',
    context: {
      client: {
        clientName: 'MWEB', clientVersion: '2.20240923.02.00', hl: 'en', gl: 'US',
      },
    },
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (iPad; CPU OS 17_4 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.4 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1',
      'X-Goog-Api-Format-Version': '2',
    },
  },
};

async function getVisitorData(gapisEndpoint, context, headers) {
  const res = await fetch(`${gapisEndpoint}visitor_id?prettyPrint=false`, {
    method: 'POST', headers, body: JSON.stringify({ context }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`visitor_id HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const data = await res.json();
  const vd = data?.responseContext?.visitorData;
  if (!vd) throw new Error('could not get visitorData');
  return vd;
}

async function resolve(urlStr, context, headers, needVisitor = false) {
  if (needVisitor) {
    const gapisBase = urlStr.substring(0, urlStr.indexOf('/player'));
    context.client.visitorData = await getVisitorData(gapisBase + '/', context, headers);
  }
  const res = await fetch(urlStr, {
    method: 'POST', headers,
    body: JSON.stringify({ context, videoId: VIDEO_ID, racyCheckOk: true, contentCheckOk: true }),
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`player HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const data = await res.json();
  const sd = data.streamingData;
  if (!sd) {
    const ps = data.playabilityStatus || {};
    throw new Error(`no streamingData playability=${ps.status} reason=${ps.reason}`);
  }
  const formats = [...(sd.adaptiveFormats || []), ...(sd.formats || [])];
  const audios = formats.filter((f) => f.mimeType && f.mimeType.includes('audio/'));
  if (!audios.length) throw new Error('no audio formats');
  audios.sort((a, b) => {
    const aO = a.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
    const bO = b.mimeType.includes('opus') ? 1 : 0;
    if (aO !== bO) return bO - aO;
    return (b.bitrate || 0) - (a.bitrate || 0);
  });
  const best = audios[0];
  if (!best.url) throw new Error(`best has no url (itag ${best.itag}) cipher=${!!best.signatureCipher}`);
  return {
    url: best.url, itag: best.itag, mime: best.mimeType,
    bitrate: best.bitrate, clen: best.contentLength,
    host: new URL(best.url).host,
  };
}

async function probeRange(url, rangeHeader) {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(url, { headers: { Range: rangeHeader } });
    const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();
    return {
      status: r.status, bytes: buf.byteLength,
      clen: r.headers.get('content-length'), cr: r.headers.get('content-range'),
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 'ERR', bytes: 0, clen: '-', cr: String(e) };
  }
}

(async () => {
  const def = CLIENTS[CLIENT];
  if (!def) {
    console.error(`Unknown YOUTUBE_PLAYER_CLIENT="${CLIENT}". Options: ${Object.keys(CLIENTS).join(', ')}`);
    process.exit(2);
  }
  console.log(`CLIENT: ${CLIENT}`);
  const needVisitor = CLIENT === 'visionos';
  const info = await resolve(def.endpoint, def.context, def.headers, needVisitor);
  console.log(`URL HOST: ${info.host}`);
  console.log(`ITAG: ${info.itag}  MIME: ${info.mime}  BITRATE: ${info.bitrate}  CLEN: ${info.clen}`);

  // raw probe, SAME URL every request, no re-resolve
  const results = [];
  for (const c of CHUNKS) {
    const r = await probeRange(info.url, c.range);
    results.push({ ...c, ...r });
  }
  const urlStrings = Array(4).fill(info.url);
  const same = urlStrings.every((u) => u === urlStrings[0]);

  console.log('URL SAME: ' + (same ? 'YES' : 'NO'));
  for (const r of results) {
    console.log(`${r.label}: status=${r.status} clen=${r.clen} content-range=${r.cr} bytes=${r.bytes}`);
  }
  const chunk2 = results.find((r) => r.label === 'chunk2');
  const chunk3 = results.find((r) => r.label === 'chunk3');
  const chunk4 = results.find((r) => r.label === 'chunk4');
  const ok = (r) => r && (r.status === 206 || r.status === 200);
  console.log(`chunk2 >512KB: ${ok(chunk2) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);
  console.log(`chunk3 >512KB: ${ok(chunk3) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);
  console.log(`chunk4 >512KB: ${ok(chunk4) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'}`);
})().catch((e) => {
  console.error(`RESOLVE FAILED: ${e.message}`);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```javascript
const { execFileSync } = require('node:child_process');

// npm run release - bump, show changes, commit, push to main. No force, no amend, no reset.
// Aborts if the tree contains changes outside the version-file set.
const VERSION_FILES = new Set([
  'package.json',
  'package-lock.json',
  'public/app.js',
  'public/index.html',
  'public/sw.js',
  'public/manifest.json',
]);

function sh(cmd, args, opts = {}) {
  return execFileSync(cmd, args, { encoding: 'utf8', ...opts }).trim();
}

function changedFiles() {
  const out = sh('git', ['status', '--porcelain']);
  if (!out) return [];
  return out.split('\n').map((l) => l.slice(3).trim()).filter(Boolean);
}

try {
  const before = changedFiles();
  const unrelated = before.filter((f) => !VERSION_FILES.has(f));
  if (unrelated.length) {
    console.error('Refusing release: unrelated working-tree changes present:');
    unrelated.forEach((f) => console.error(`  ${f}`));
    console.error('Commit/stash those first, then re-run.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('--- bump ---');
  sh('node', ['scripts/bump.js'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  const pkg = require('../package.json');
  console.log('--- diff stat ---');
  sh('git', ['diff', '--stat'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  console.log('--- status ---');
  sh('git', ['status', '--short'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  const after = changedFiles();
  const stillUnrelated = after.filter((f) => !VERSION_FILES.has(f));
  if (stillUnrelated.length) {
    console.error('Refusing commit: unexpected files changed:');
    stillUnrelated.forEach((f) => console.error(`  ${f}`));
    process.exit(1);
  }
  if (!after.length) {
    console.error('Nothing to commit after bump.');
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('--- commit ---');
  sh('git', ['add', ...[...VERSION_FILES].filter((f) => after.includes(f))]);
  sh('git', ['commit', '-m', `v${pkg.version}`]);
  console.log('--- push origin main ---');
  sh('git', ['push', 'origin', 'main'], { stdio: 'inherit' });
  console.log(`Released v${pkg.version}`);
} catch (e) {
  console.error(`release FAILED: ${(e && e.message) || e}`);
  if (e && e.stdout) console.error(e.stdout);
  if (e && e.stderr) console.error(e.stderr);
  process.exit(1);
}
```

```markdown
## Detail per lagu

### ?-autonext → NO_END

- endPos=-1 duration=-1 endVerdict=-
- stutter=0 (STALL_3S=0, tickGap>3.5s=0, maxGap=0ms)
- rebuffers=0 bufferSec=0.0
- errors: -
- setupFail=false

## Cara baca

- Stutter: gap tick >3.5s saat posisi beku + event STALL_3S. Bandingkan antar mode.
- End Pos vs Durasi: end <90% durasi = skip prematur.
- PASS: stutter <2 dan end genuine/penuh. NO_END: lagu tak selesai dalam timeout. SETUP_FAIL: resolve/prefix gagal (jaringan/perizinan, bukan salah engine).
```

```markdown
# Analisis Stutter 4.093s — hgqirobgM8E @44.9s (investigasi kode, TANPA fix)

Status: analisis statis selesai. Tidak ada kode diubah, tidak ada log ditambah.

## 1. Trace read: ExoPlayer → GrowingFileDataSource → file

`ExoPlaybackEngine.startItem` (ExoPlaybackEngine.java:395-427):
`ProgressiveMediaSource.Factory(dsFactory).createMediaSource(MediaItem.fromUri(uri))`
(405-406) → `player.setMediaSource(source, startMs)` (419/421) →
`prepare()` + `play()` (423-424). Extractor membaca via Loader thread
memanggil `GrowingFileDataSource.read()` berulang.

`GrowingFileDataSource.read()` (GrowingFileDataSource.java:124-188),
tiap iterasi re-resolve file (129) lalu `GrowingReadPolicy.decide`
(131-133):

- `READ` (pos < have, policy GrowingReadPolicy.java:39): `want =
  min(length, have-position)` (136); open `RandomAccessFile`, `seek(position)`,
  `read(≤ min(want, SERVE_BUF=65536))` (141-146, SERVE_BUF line 70);
  `position += n`, `consumed` update (148-149); close RAF (157-160);
  `return n` (151). **Tanpa sleep, tanpa block.**
- `HOLD` (pos >= have, file belum COMPLETE, policy lines 40-44):
  log throttled 5s (170-174), timeout 20s → IOException (175-178),
  `Thread.sleep(POLL_MS=100)` (179-184, POLL_MS line 68).
- `END_OF_INPUT` hanya bila COMPLETE (policy line 40; source 162-163).
- `ERROR_FAILED` bila writer FAILED (policy 38; source 164-165).

`open()` (91-121): block sampai file ada (98-116), return
`LENGTH_UNSET` (119-120) — selalu, karena `totalBytes()` hardcoded `-1L`
(ExoPlaybackEngine.java:342-344) dan MediaItem tanpa length (405-406).

Jawaban kunci FASE 1:
- read() TIDAK sleep per call di jalur data; maks 64KB/call.
- Random access YA via RAF seek (144); backward seek bebas (pos<have→READ);
  forward seek melewati have → HOLD.
- Source "tahu" growing: EOF hanya saat COMPLETE; selain itu HOLD/retry.
  `.part→.webm` rename terdeteksi karena re-resolve tiap iterasi (129).

## 2. LoadControl aktual (ExoPlaybackEngine.java:243-247)

`setBufferDurationsMs(5000, 10000, 2500, 5000)` =
min 5s / max 10s / playback 2.5s / afterRebuffer 5s;
`setTargetBufferBytes(8MB)`; `prioritizeTimeOverSize(true)`; backBuffer 30s.

Penilaian: config wajar, tidak terlalu kecil. Keluar rebuffer butuh 5s
media (~40-80KB @opus 251). `targetBufferBytes` 8MB tak relevan untuk file
kecil karena time-threshold menang. Max 10s membatasi read-ahead (~160KB),
jauh di bawah windowEnd — tidak ada parameter yang memaksa rebuffer
berulang dari sisi config.

## 3. Interaksi dengan SongCache window + deadlock?

Reader NOL window-coupling: tidak ada referensi setWindow/pauseDownload/
isDownloading di GrowingFileDataSource.java maupun GrowingReadPolicy.java
(hanya isComplete/getStatus/partFile via FileState). **Tidak ada deadlock**
(circular wait mustahil: reader tak pernah menahan lock yang writer butuhkan;
pause writer bersifat advisory flag).

Writer gating (semua di NativeAudioEngine.java):
- `setWindow` (900-920): pause bila `hasBytes(min(windowEnd,total))`
  (908-911); resume via thread download baru (915-918).
- Tick enforcement (1958-1972): chunk-cross → setWindow; cap-hit → pause
  (1968-1969). **Tick hanya jalan saat PLAYING.**
- Watchdog re-drive (1993-2006): frozen 3s + have<windowEnd → setWindow.
  **Di dalam tick → mati saat BUFFERING.**
- Stall delegate: engine poll 3s → `onPlayerStalled` → `requestWindowAdvance`
  (1129-1135 → 975-992). Tapi poll engine mensyaratkan `player.isPlaying()`
  — false saat rebuffer — **jadi mati juga saat BUFFERING.**

**Liveness gap terkonfirmasi**: selama BUFFERING, ketiga pemicu resume-writer
yang bergantung pada PLAYING mati. Kombinasi HOLD + writer-paused hanya bisa
pulih via (a) resume eksternal, atau (b) timeout 20s → IOException → error.
Stutter ini pulih dalam 4s → mekanisme (a), penyebab resume tak terlihat dari
cuplikan log yang diberikan.

Paradoks "data 2.15MB ada tapi butuh 5KB": jika `have` benar 2.15MB selama
stall dan posisi read ≈640KB, jalur READ (tanpa sleep, ≤64KB/call, overhead
~1ms) **tidak mungkin** selambat 1.25KB/s. Maka salah satu: (i) posisi read
extractor jauh di depan pos playback (read-ahead menabrak region belum
tertulis saat writer paused — perlu `byte needed` log untuk konfirmasi);
(ii) angka 2.15MB diukur SETELAH recovery, bukan selama stall; atau
(iii) bottleneck di sisi loader/extractor (stream LENGTH_UNSET). TIDAK YAKIN
mana yang benar tanpa log timestamp per-baris — lihat bukti yang diminta.

## 4. Root cause (ranking)

1. **HOLD + writer-paused + liveness gap (kandidat utama).** Poll 100ms/
   iter + tidak ada pemicu resume saat BUFFERING menjelaskan stall
   multi-detik yang pulih sendiri begitu writer jalan lagi. 5KB/4s =
   trickle writer yang baru resume (atau jaringan seret).
2. **Inefisiensi per-read (sekunder).** RAF open+close tiap call (141-160)
   + cap 64KB (70, 145-146): overhead nyata tapi orde ms — tidak menjelaskan
   1.25KB/s sendirian. Formulir "tahu file tumbuh" sudah benar (HOLD, bukan EOF).
3. **LENGTH_UNSET permanen (sekunder).** `totalBytes()=-1` (ExoPlaybackEngine.
   java:342-344) → extractor tanpa length: seeking/buffering suboptimal,
   END_OF_INPUT akurat hanya via COMPLETE. Berkontribusi, bukan pemicu 4s.
4. **Bukan LoadControl.** Nilai wajar; tidak memaksa rebuffer.

Bukan deadlock. File .part secara prinsip BISA dibaca full-speed — yang
melambat adalah ketersediaan byte (writer) atau posisi read, bukan syscall read.

## 5. Hipotesis fix (JANGAN implementasi — prioritas + risiko)

- **H1 (prioritas 1): sinyal reader→writer.** Saat `read()` masuk HOLD
  (atau N hold beruntun), panggil `requestWindowAdvance`/setWindow untuk
  membangunkan writer seketika, ganti trigger PLAYING-gated. Risiko: churn
  restart writer di jaringan flaky; mitigasi debounce ala RECOVERY_DEBOUNCE.
- **H2 (prioritas 2): RAF reuse + SERVE_BUF 256KB.** Satu handle terbuka
  lintas read (reopen saat identitas file berubah), cap naik 64→256KB.
  Risiko: handle basi saat rename .part→.webm; mitigasi reopen on change.
- **H3 (prioritas 3): totalBytes nyata.** Umbar `clen` resolver (sudah ada
  sebagai `lastTotal` di NAE) ke FileState agar length known → seek/buffer
  extractor akurat. Risiko: clen bohong/berubah (refresh 403) → EOF prematur;
  mitigasi fallback -1 saat mismatch.
- **H4 (wajib dulu): log diagnostik.** Sampling latensi+size READ, entry/exit
  HOLD (pos/have/writerState), pause/resume writer + alasan + timestamp.
  Satu run repro dengan log ini untuk memilih H1 vs H3 sebelum sentuh kode.

Test runtime perlu sebelum fix: YA — run instrumen tangkap stall + log H4.

## 6. Pertanyaan ke user

1. Pilih approach: H1 (wake writer), H2 (efisiensi read), H3 (length nyata),
   atau H4-dulu (log + repro)?
2. Minta cuplikan log ±30s sekitar 11:53:05: baris `[EXO] byte needed`,
   `[NAE] window`, `[NAE] writer`, `writerState`, dan ukuran file per menit
   — untuk memastikan `have` saat stall vs sesudahnya.
3. Konfirmasi satuan "44.9KB→50.0KB" (byte buffered-ahead? `buf=` ms?
   baris log mentah mana?).
```

### Path: scripts/test-2d-notification.sh

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Verifikasi fix 2D (shared ExoPlayer MediaSession). TANPA interaksi manual.
# Satu command:  bash scripts/test-2d-notification.sh
# Idempotent; tiap run dir output baru di /tmp (atau $T2D_OUT).
#
# TIDAK flip USE_EXOPLAYER di production: mode native test-activity
# mengaktifkan backend exo via test override (ExoPlayerFlags).
set -uo pipefail

APK_PATH="${APK_PATH:-android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk}"
ACTIVITY="com.dnialify.musicstream/.ExoPlaybackTestActivity"
PKG="com.dnialify.musicstream"
OUTPUT_DIR="${T2D_OUT:-/tmp/t2d-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}"
PLAY_WAIT_SEC="${PLAY_WAIT_SEC:-180}"
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

log() { echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] $*"; }
mark() { adb shell "log -p d -t TEST2D '$*'" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true; }

count=$(adb devices | grep -c "device$" || true)
if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
    log "ERROR: Tidak ada device. Colok HP dan aktifkan USB debugging."
    exit 1
fi
log "Device: $(adb devices | grep "device$" | head -1)"

if [ ! -f "$APK_PATH" ]; then
    log "ERROR: APK tidak ada: $APK_PATH. Build dulu dari dir android/."
    exit 1
fi
log "Install APK..."
adb install -r "$APK_PATH"

log "Start native loop (backend exo via test override)..."
adb logcat -c
adb shell am start -n "$ACTIVITY" \
    --es mode native \
    --ei targetPlays 10 \
    --ei songTimeoutSec 600 \
    --ez exitOnEnd false > /dev/null

log "Tunggu PLAYING backend=exo (maks ${PLAY_WAIT_SEC}s)..."
playing=0
start=$(date +%s)
while true; do
    now=$(date +%s)
    if [ $((now - start)) -gt "$PLAY_WAIT_SEC" ]; then break; fi
    if adb logcat -d 2>/dev/null | grep -F "[NATIVE_STATE]" | grep -Eq 'state["=: ]+PLAYING|-> PLAYING'; then
        if adb logcat -d 2>/dev/null | grep -F "[AUTONEXT-TEST] backend=exo" | grep -q exo; then
            playing=1
            break
        fi
    fi
    sleep 5
done
if [ "$playing" -ne 1 ]; then
    log "ERROR: tidak mencapai PLAYING exo dalam ${PLAY_WAIT_SEC}s"
    adb shell dumpsys audio > "$OUTPUT_DIR/audio-focus.txt" 2>&1 || true
    adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/t2d.log"
    node scripts/parse-2d-notification.js "$OUTPUT_DIR" || true
    adb shell am force-stop "$PKG" > /dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi
log "PLAYING tercapai."

# ---------- T1: notifikasi muncul ----------
log "T1: dumpsys notification..."
adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact > "$OUTPUT_DIR/notif-playing.txt" 2>&1 || true
mark "T1 dumpsys taken"

# ---------- T2: pause/resume via broadcast ----------
log "T2: broadcast MEDIA_PAUSE..."
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_PAUSE > /dev/null
mark "T2 pause sent"
sleep 6
adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/log-t2-pause.txt"
log "T2: broadcast MEDIA_PLAY..."
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_PLAY > /dev/null
mark "T2 play sent"
sleep 6
adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/log-t2-play.txt"

# ---------- T3: next via broadcast ----------
log "T3: broadcast MEDIA_NEXT..."
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_NEXT > /dev/null
mark "T3 next sent"
sleep 8
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_SEEK --ei seconds 30 > /dev/null
mark "T3 seek sent"
sleep 5
adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/log-t3.txt"

# ---------- T4: media dispatch (BT/sim) ----------
log "T4: media dispatch pause/play..."
adb shell cmd media_session dispatch pause > "$OUTPUT_DIR/dispatch-pause.txt" 2>&1 || true
mark "T4 dispatch pause sent"
sleep 6
adb shell cmd media_session dispatch play > "$OUTPUT_DIR/dispatch-play.txt" 2>&1 || true
mark "T4 dispatch play sent"
sleep 6
adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/log-t4.txt"

# ---------- T5: ongoing flag playing vs paused ----------
log "T5: dumpsys saat paused..."
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_PAUSE > /dev/null
sleep 6
adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact > "$OUTPUT_DIR/notif-paused.txt" 2>&1 || true
adb shell am broadcast -a com.dnialify.MEDIA_PLAY > /dev/null
sleep 5

# ---------- T6: hitung notifikasi ----------
log "T6: hitung notifikasi package..."
adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact > "$OUTPUT_DIR/notif-final.txt" 2>&1 || true

sleep 2
adb logcat -d > "$OUTPUT_DIR/t2d.log"
log "Log: $OUTPUT_DIR/t2d.log"
adb shell am force-stop "$PKG" > /dev/null || true

log "Parsing..."
node scripts/parse-2d-notification.js "$OUTPUT_DIR"
log "=== SELESAI ==="
log "Report: $OUTPUT_DIR/report.md"
```
